24Algorithms Study Guide

Algorithms Study Guide — Kaise Use Karo

Ye section algorithms aur data structures ka practical knowledge deta hai jo coding interviews me baar-baar aate hain. Jitni zyada techniques tumhare paas hongi, interview pass karne ke chances utne zyada honge. Techniques corner cases dhoondhne me bhi madad karti hain aur optimal approach ki taraf le jaati hain.

Har study guide me kya milega

  1. Ek brief overview
  2. Learning resources
  3. Language-specific libraries
  4. Time complexities cheatsheet
  5. Interview me dhyaan rakhne wali baatein
  6. Corner cases
  7. Useful techniques + recommended practice questions

Topics aur priority

TopicPriority
ArrayHigh
StringHigh
Hash TableMid
RecursionMid
Sorting and searchingHigh
MatrixHigh
Linked ListMid
QueueMid
StackMid
TreeHigh
GraphHigh
HeapMid
TrieMid
IntervalMid
Dynamic programmingLow
BinaryLow
MathLow
GeometryLow

General interview tips

  • Jo assumptions tumne subconsciously bana li hain, unhe clarify karo. Bahut se questions jaan-boojhkar under-specified hote hain.
  • Hamesha pehle input validate karo — invalid/empty/negative/different type input check karo. Assume mat karo ki valid parameters mile hain. Ya interviewer se clarify karo ki valid input assume kar sakte ho (aam taur par haan) — isse validation code likhne ka time bachta hai.
  • Kya time/space complexity requirements ya constraints hain?
  • Off-by-one errors check karo.
  • Jin languages me automatic type coercion nahi hai, wahan concatenation se pehle check karo ki values same type ki hon (int/str/list).
  • Code khatm karke kuch example inputs se test karo.
  • Kya algorithm multiple times run hoga (jaise web server me)? Agar haan, to input ko preprocess karke har call ki efficiency badha sakte ho.
  • Functional aur imperative paradigms ka mix use karo — pure functions likho jahan ho sake (reason karna aasaan, bugs kam), lekin functional code space me mehenga hota hai (non-mutation se baar-baar naye objects allocate hote hain), imperative code fast hota hai (existing objects par operate karte ho). Accuracy vs efficiency ka balance rakho.
  • Global variables par rely mat karo aur unhe mutate mat karo — global variables state introduce karte hain. Agar rely karna hi pade to galti se mutate na ho, iska dhyaan rakho.
  • Program ko fast karne ke do tareeke: (1) zyada appropriate data structure/algorithm chuno; (2) zyada memory use karo. Ye classic space vs time tradeoff hai — lekin hamesha zaroori nahi ki speed sirf space ki keemat par mile. Aur dhyaan rakho ki program kitna fast ho sakta hai, iski theoretical limit hoti hai — jaise unsorted array me smallest/largest element dhoondhna O(n) se fast nahi ho sakta.
  • Data structures tumhare weapons hain — sahi battle ke liye sahi weapon chunna hi jeet ki kunji hai. Har data structure ki strengths aur time complexities achhe se jaano.
  • Data structures ko augment karke multiple operations me efficient time complexity mil sakti hai — jaise hash map + doubly-linked list se LRU cache me get aur put dono O(1) ho jaate hain.
  • Hash table shayad algorithm questions me sabse zyada use hone wala data structure hai. Atak jao to common data structures ki list se ek-ek karke socho ki kaunsa apply ho sakta hai — ye kabhi-kabhi kaam kar jaata hai.
  • Agar code me corners cut kar rahe ho to interviewer ko zor se batao aur kaho non-interview setting me kya karte — jaise regex use karte split() ke bajay jo kuch cases cover na kare.
Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/study-cheatsheet.md
← PehleInterviewer Cheatsheet — Do's aur Don'tsAgla →Array
25Algorithms Study Guide

Array

Arrays me same type ki values contiguous memory locations par store hoti hain. Array me aam taur par do cheezein matter karti hain — element ki position/index aur element khud. Alag-alag languages arrays ko under the hood alag tareeke se implement karti hain, jisse operations ki time complexity badal sakti hai. Python, JavaScript, Ruby, PHP jaise languages me array ka size dynamic hota hai — pehle se size define karne ki jaroorat nahi hoti, isliye interviews me ye languages aasaan lagti hain.

Arrays interviews me sabse common data structures me se hain. Doosre topics ke questions me bhi arrays/sequences aane ki sambhavna hoti hai. Array ki mastery interviews ke liye essential hai.

Advantages: ek hi variable naam se same type ke multiple elements store kar sakte ho; index pata ho to elements ko access karna fast hai (linked lists me head se traverse karna padta hai). Disadvantages: beech me elements add/remove karna slow hai kyunki baaki elements shift karne padte hain (end par insert/remove exception hai); fixed-size languages me size badhane par naya array allocate karke elements copy karne padte hain — O(n) time lagta hai.

Common terms

  • Subarray — array ke andar contiguous values ka range. Example: array [2, 3, 6, 1, 5, 4] me [3, 6, 1] subarray hai, lekin [3, 1, 5] nahi hai.
  • Subsequence — kuch ya koi bhi elements delete karke banaya gaya sequence, baaki elements ka order same rehta hai. Example: [3, 1, 5] subsequence hai lekin [3, 5, 1] nahi hai.

Time complexity

OperationBig-ONote
AccessO(1)
SearchO(n)
Search (sorted array)O(log(n))
InsertO(n)Baad wale elements ko right shift karna padta hai
Insert (at the end)O(1)Koi shift nahi chahiye
RemoveO(n)Baad wale elements ko left shift karna padta hai
Remove (at the end)O(1)Koi shift nahi chahiye

Interview me dhyaan rakhne wali baatein

  • Clarify karo duplicate values hain ya nahi — answer par farq padega? Question aasaan ya mushkil hoga?
  • Index se iterate karte waqt out-of-bounds se bacho.
  • Arrays ko slice ya concatenate karna aam taur par O(n) leta hai — jahan ho sake start aur end indices se subarray demarcate karo.

Corner cases

Empty sequence; 1 ya 2 elements wali sequence; repeated elements wali sequence; duplicate values wali sequence.

Techniques

Arrays aur strings dono sequences hain (string characters ka array hai), isliye zyada tar techniques string problems par bhi apply hoti hain.

  • Sliding window — bahut se subarray/substring problems par apply hoti hai. Dono pointers same direction me chalte hain aur kabhi ek-doosre ko overtake nahi karte — har value zyada se zyada do baar visit hoti hai, time complexity O(n) rehti hai. Examples: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters, Minimum Size Subarray Sum, Minimum Window Substring.
  • Two pointers — sliding window ka zyada general version; pointers cross kar sakte hain aur alag arrays par ho sakte hain. Examples: Sort Colors, Palindromic Substrings. Do arrays process karne hon to har array ke liye ek pointer rakho — jaise do sorted arrays merge karna.
  • Peeche se traverse karna — kabhi-kabhi right se traverse karna behtar hota hai. Examples: Daily Temperatures, Number of Visible People in a Queue.
  • Array sort karna — array sorted ya partially sorted hai? Agar hai to kisi form ki binary search possible hai — interviewer O(n) se fast solution chahta hai. Array sort kar sakte ho? Kabhi-kabhi sort karne se problem bahut simplify ho jaata hai (agar order preserve karna zaroori na ho). Examples: Merge Intervals, Non-overlapping Intervals.
  • Precomputation — subarray ke sum ya multiplication wale questions me hashing ya prefix/suffix sum/product se pre-computation useful hoti hai. Examples: Product of Array Except Self, Minimum Size Subarray Sum.
  • Index as a hash key — O(1) space maanga jaaye to array ko khud hash table ki tarah use kar sakte ho. Array me sirf 1 se N values hon (N = length) to us index (minus one) ki value negate karke presence dikhao. Examples: First Missing Positive, Daily Temperatures.
  • Array ko ek se zyada baar traverse karna — do/teen baar traverse karna (n se kam baar) phir bhi O(n) hi hota hai. Kabhi-kabhi multiple traversals se problem solve ho jaata hai aur time complexity O(n) rehti hai.

Essential questions

Two Sum · Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock · Product of Array Except Self · Maximum Subarray

Recommended practice questions

Contains Duplicate · Maximum Product Subarray · Search in Rotated Sorted Array · 3Sum · Container With Most Water · Sliding Window Maximum

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/array.md
← PehleAlgorithms Study Guide — Kaise Use KaroAgla →String
26Algorithms Study Guide

String

String characters ka sequence hai. Array par apply hone wale bahut se tips strings par bhi apply hote hain — String padhne se pehle Array wala page padhna recommended hai.

Strings lookup ke liye common data structures: Trie/Prefix Tree, Suffix Tree. Common string algorithms: Rabin Karp (rolling hash se efficient substring search), KMP (efficient substring search).

Time complexity

OperationBig-O
AccessO(1)
SearchO(n)
InsertO(n)
RemoveO(n)

Doosri string (length m) ke saath operations: Find substring O(n·m) (naive case — KMP jaise efficient algorithms bhi hain); Concatenating strings O(n + m); Slice O(m); Split (by token) O(n + m); Strip O(n).

Interview me dhyaan rakhne wali baatein

Input character set aur case sensitivity ke baare me poochho. Aam taur par characters lowercase Latin characters (a se z) tak limited hote hain.

Corner cases

Empty string; 1 ya 2 characters wali string; repeated characters wali string; sirf distinct characters wali string.

Techniques

Characters count karna

Aksar string me characters ki frequency count karni padti hai — hash table/map use karo. Python me built-in Counter class ho to poochho ki use kar sakte ho ya nahi. Common galti: counter ke liye space complexity O(n) bolna — Latin characters ki string ke liye space O(1) hoti hai, kyunki upper bound characters ki range hai (fixed constant 26), nahi ki input size.

Unique characters wali string ka trick: 26-bit bitmask use karo — kaunse lowercase Latin characters string me hain, ye dikhane ke liye. Do strings me common characters hain ya nahi, ye check karne ke liye dono bitmasks ka & karo — result non-zero ho to common characters hain.

Anagram

Anagram ek word ya phrase ke letters ko rearrange karke naya word/phrase banana hai, saare original letters ek hi baar use karke. Interviews me aam taur par bina spaces wale words hi matter karte hain. Do strings anagram hain ya nahi, ye check karne ke tareeke: dono strings sort karo — same result aana chahiye (O(n log n) time, O(n) space); har character ko prime number map karo aur multiply karo — anagrams ka multiple same hoga (O(n) time, O(1) space); characters ki frequency count karo (O(n) time, O(1) space).

Palindrome

Palindrome wo word/phrase/number hai jo aage se aur peeche se same padha jaata hai, jaise madam ya racecar. Check karne ke tareeke: string ko reverse karo — khud ke barabar honi chahiye; ya do pointers start aur end par rakho, andar ki taraf move karo — har point par dono pointers ke characters match hone chahiye.

Characters ka order matter karta hai, isliye hash tables helpful nahi hote. Palindromes ginne ho to common trick hai do pointers ko middle se bahar ki taraf move karna. Palindromes even ya odd length ke ho sakte hain — har middle pivot position ko do baar check karna padta hai (character include karke aur bina). Substrings ke liye match na hote hi early terminate kar sakte ho; subsequences ke liye dynamic programming use karo kyunki overlapping subproblems hote hain.

Essential questions

Valid Anagram · Valid Palindrome · Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters

Recommended practice questions

Longest Repeating Character Replacement · Find All Anagrams in a String · Minimum Window Substring · Group Anagrams · Longest Palindromic Substring · Encode and Decode Strings (Premium)

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/string.md
← PehleArrayAgla →Hash Table
27Algorithms Study Guide

Hash Table

Hash table (hash map) ek data structure hai jo associative array implement karta hai — keys ko values se map karta hai. Hash table element par hash function lagakar ek index (hash code) compute karta hai, jahan value store hoti hai. Lookup ke waqt key ko hash kiya jaata hai aur resulting hash batata hai ki value kahan stored hai.

Hashing space-time tradeoff ka sabse common example hai. Array ko har baar linearly search karne ke bajay (O(n) time), array ko ek baar traverse karke saare elements hash table me daal do. Element present hai ya nahi, ye check karna sirf us element ko hash karke dekhna hai ki hash table me hai ya nahi — average O(1).

Hash collisions: collisions resolve karne ke techniques hain — interviews me inki detail aam taur par nahi poochhi jaati. Separate chaining — har value ke liye linked list use hoti hai, collided items store karne ke liye. Open addressing — saare entry records bucket array me hi store hote hain; nayi entry insert karte waqt hashed slot se shuru karke probe sequence me buckets check kiye jaate hain jab tak khaali slot na mil jaaye.

Implementations

LanguageAPI
C++std::unordered_map
Javajava.util.Map (HashMap use karo)
Pythondict
JavaScriptObject ya Map

Time complexity

OperationBig-ONote
AccessN/AAccess possible nahi — hash code pata nahi hota
SearchO(1)*Average case
InsertO(1)*Average case
RemoveO(1)*Average case

* Average case hai, lekin interviews me hash tables ke liye sirf average case hi matter karta hai.

Sample questions

Least-used cache ka implementation describe karo aur uski big-O notation batao. API integration wala question jisme hash map ke buckets linked lists se bane hon.

Essential questions

Two Sum · Ransom Note

Recommended practice questions

Group Anagrams · Insert Delete GetRandom O(1) · First Missing Positive · LRU Cache · All O one Data Structure

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/hash-table.md
← PehleStringAgla →Recursion
28Algorithms Study Guide

Recursion

Recursion problem solve karne ka tareeka hai jisme solution chhote instances ke solutions par depend karta hai. Har recursive function ke do parts hote hain: (1) base case (ya cases) — jahan recursion rukti hai, warna hamesha chalti rahegi; (2) problem ko chhote subproblems me todna aur recursive call karna.

Sabse common example Fibonacci sequence hai — base cases fib(0) = 0 aur fib(1) = 1; recurrence relation fib(i) = fib(i-1) + fib(i-2). Bahut se algorithms recursion ka heavy use karte hain — binary search, merge sort, tree traversal, depth-first search, etc. Is page ka focus un questions par hai jo recursion use karte hain lekin kisi well-known algorithm ka part nahi hain.

Interview me dhyaan rakhne wali baatein

  • Hamesha base case define karo taaki recursion end ho.
  • Recursion permutation ke liye useful hai — saare combinations generate karti hai — aur tree-based questions ke liye. Sequence ke saare permutations generate karna aana chahiye, duplicates handle karna bhi.
  • Recursion implicitly stack use karti hai — har recursive approach ko stack use karke iterative bhi likha ja sakta hai. Dhyaan rakho recursion level bahut deep jaaye to stack overflow ho sakta hai (Python me default limit 1000 hai). Ye point batane par bonus points mil sakte hain. Recursion kabhi O(1) space complexity nahi ho sakti kyunki stack involve hota hai — sirf tail-call optimization (TCO) ho to alag baat hai. Apni language TCO support karti hai ya nahi, ye pata karo.
  • Base cases ki sankhya — Fibonacci example me recursive calls fib(n-2) bhi invoke karti hain, isliye 2 base cases hone chahiye taaki saare invocations cover hon. Agar recursive function sirf fn(n-1) invoke karta hai to sirf ek base case kaafi hai.

Corner cases

n = 0; n = 1; kaafi base cases hon taaki recursive function ke saare possible invocations cover hon.

Techniques — Memoization

Kabhi-kabhi pehle compute kiye gaye inputs ke results dobaara compute ho rahe hote hain. Fibonacci me fib(5), fib(4) aur fib(3) call karta hai, aur fib(4), fib(3) aur fib(2) call karta hai — fib(3) do baar call ho raha hai. Agar fib(3) ki value memoize karke reuse karo to efficiency bahut badh jaati hai aur time complexity O(n) ho jaati hai.

Essential questions

Generate Parentheses · Combinations · Subsets

Recommended practice questions

Letter Combinations of a Phone Number · Subsets II · Permutations · Sudoku Solver · Strobogrammatic Number II (Premium)

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/recursion.md
← PehleHash TableAgla →Sorting aur Searching
29Algorithms Study Guide

Sorting aur Searching

Sorting matlab sequence ke elements ko order me rearrange karna — numerical ya lexicographical order me, ascending ya descending. Kai basic algorithms O(n²) me chalte hain aur interviews me use nahi karne chahiye. Algorithm interviews me sorting algorithms ko scratch se implement karna aam taur par nahi padta — input ko language ke default sorting function se sort karke us par binary search use karna hota hai.

Sorted array par uski sorted property ka fayda uthakar O(n) se fast search ki ja sakti hai — binary search se. Binary search target value ko middle element se compare karta hai, jisse pata chalta hai ki target left half me hai ya right half me, aur ye comparison bache hue half par chalta rehta hai jab tak target mil na jaaye ya half khaali na ho jaaye.

Time complexity

AlgorithmTimeSpace
Bubble sortO(n²)O(1)
Insertion sortO(n²)O(1)
Selection sortO(n²)O(1)
QuicksortO(n log n)O(log n)
MergesortO(n log n)O(n)
HeapsortO(n log n)O(1)
Counting sortO(n + k)O(k)
Radix sortO(nk)O(n + k)
Binary searchO(log n)—

Interview me dhyaan rakhne wali baatein

Apni language ke default sorting algorithm ki time aur space complexity zaroor jaano. Time complexity lagbhag pakka O(n log n) hoti hai. Bonus points milte hain agar sort ka naam bata sako — Python 3.11+ me default Powersort hai (Timsort ko replace karke); Java me objects sort karne ke liye Timsort ka implementation aur primitives sort karne ke liye Dual-Pivot Quicksort use hota hai.

Corner cases

Empty sequence; 1 element wali sequence; 2 elements wali sequence; duplicate elements wali sequence.

Techniques

  • Sorted inputs — sequence sorted order me ho (ascending ya descending) to binary search sabse pehle dimaag me aana chahiye.
  • Limited range wala input sort karna — Counting sort ek non-comparison-based sort hai jo numbers par use kar sakte ho jab values ki range pehle se pata ho. Example: H-Index.

Essential questions

Binary Search · Search in Rotated Sorted Array

Recommended practice questions

Kth Smallest Element in a Sorted Matrix · Search a 2D Matrix · Kth Largest Element in an Array · Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array · Median of Two Sorted Arrays

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/sorting-searching.md
← PehleRecursionAgla →Matrix
30Algorithms Study Guide

Matrix

Matrix ek 2-dimensional array hai. Matrix wale questions aam taur par dynamic programming ya graph traversal se related hote hain. Matrices graphs ko represent karne ke liye use ho sakti hain — har cell ek node hai jiske 4 neighbors hote hain (edges aur corners ke alawa). Is page ka focus un questions par hai jo matrix ko graph ki tarah use nahi karte; matrix-as-graph wale questions graph section me hain.

Corner cases

  • Empty matrix — check karo koi bhi array 0 length ka na ho.
  • 1 × 1 matrix.
  • Sirf ek row ya ek column wali matrix.

Techniques

Empty N × M matrix banana

Traversal ya dynamic programming wale questions me lagbhag hamesha same size ki copy chahiye hoti hai, empty values se initialized, visited state ya DP table store karne ke liye. Apni language me ye routine aani chahiye. Python me ek line me: zero_matrix = [[0 for _ in range(len(matrix[0]))] for _ in range(len(matrix))]. Matrix copy karna: copied_matrix = [row[:] for row in matrix].

1D aur 2D indices ke beech convert karna

m × n matrix ko m * n elements wala one-dimensional array mana ja sakta hai. Array ke zero-based index ko columns ki sankhya se divide karo to row milegi, remainder se column milega: row = index // num_columns, col = index % num_columns. Wapas convert karna: index = row * num_columns + col. Ye technique useful hoti hai jab matrix par binary search jaise algorithms apply karne hon.

Matrix transpose karna

Transpose me rows columns ban jaate hain aur columns rows. Bahut se grid-based games matrix se model kiye ja sakte hain — Tic-Tac-Toe, Sudoku, Crossword, Connect 4, Battleship, etc. Winning condition verify karne ko poochha ja sakta hai. Tic-Tac-Toe, Connect 4 aur Crosswords jaise games me verification vertical aur horizontal dono karna hota hai — ek trick ye hai ki horizontal cells verify karne wala code likho, matrix transpose karo, aur wahi logic reuse karo vertical cells verify karne ke liye (jo ab horizontal ho gaye hain). Python me transpose: transposed_matrix = [[matrix[i][j] for i in range(len(matrix))] for j in range(len(matrix[0]))].

Essential questions

Set Matrix Zeroes · Spiral Matrix

Recommended practice questions

Rotate Image · Valid Sudoku

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/matrix.md
← PehleSorting aur SearchingAgla →Linked List
31Algorithms Study Guide

Linked List

Arrays ki tarah linked list bhi sequential data represent karne ke liye use hoti hai. Ye data elements ka linear collection hai jinka order unki physical placement se nahi milta (arrays me data sequential memory blocks me hota hai). Har element me agle element ka address hota hai — nodes ka collection jo ek sequence represent karta hai. Basic form me har node me hota hai: data, aur sequence ke agle node ka reference (link).

Advantages: node ki location pata ho to insertion aur deletion O(1) hoti hai, jabki arrays me baad wale elements shift karne padte hain. Disadvantages: access time linear hai kyunki position se seedha access nahi kar sakte (arrays me arr[4] kar sakte ho) — start se traverse karna padta hai.

Types of linked lists

  • Singly linked list — har node agle node ko point karta hai, aakhri node null ko point karta hai.
  • Doubly linked list — har node me do pointers hote hain: next agle node ko aur prev pichhle node ko point karta hai. Pehle node ka prev aur aakhri node ka next null hota hai.
  • Circular linked list — singly linked list jisme aakhri node pehle node ko wapas point karta hai. Circular doubly linked list variant me pehle node ka prev aakhri node ko aur aakhri node ka next pehle node ko point karta hai.

Implementations

Common languages me sirf Java linked list implementation deta hai. Khud ki linked list likhna aasaan hai. C++: std::list; Java: java.util.LinkedList; Python: N/A; JavaScript: N/A.

Time complexity

OperationBig-ONote
AccessO(n)
SearchO(n)
InsertO(1)Insertion position tak traverse kar liya ho
RemoveO(1)Remove karne wale node tak traverse kar liya ho

Common routines

Ye routines aani chahiye kyunki bahut se linked list questions inme se ek ya zyada use karte hain: nodes ginna; linked list ko in-place reverse karna; two pointers (fast/slow) se middle node dhoondhna; do linked lists merge karna.

Corner cases

Empty linked list (head null hai); single node; do nodes; linked list me cycles hon — pehle clarify karo ki cycle ho sakti hai ya nahi. Aam taur par jawab nahi hota aur code me handle karne ki jaroorat nahi hoti.

Techniques

  • Sentinel/dummy nodes — head aur/ya tail par dummy node add karne se bahut se edge cases handle ho jaate hain jahan head ya tail par operations karne hote hain. Dummy nodes ki wajah se operations kabhi head ya tail par nahi hote, isse null pointers ke conditional checks likhne ki headache khatm ho jaati hai. Operation ke ant me unhe remove karna yaad rakho.
  • Two pointers — k-th node from last: ek pointer doosre se k nodes aage rakho; aage wala end par pahunche to doosra k nodes peeche hoga. Cycle detect karna: ek pointer doosre se dugni speed se badhao; mil jaayein to cycle hai. Middle node: ek pointer dugni speed se badhao; fast end par pahunche to slow middle par hoga.
  • Space use karna — bahut se linked list problems nayi linked list banakar aasaani se solve ho jaate hain, lekin extra space lagti hai aur question kam challenging ho jaata hai. Interviewer aam taur par kahega ki linked list ko in-place modify karo, bina additional storage ke. Reverse a Linked List wale problem se ideas lo.
  • Elegant modification operations — linked list ki non-sequential memory ki wajah se contents efficiently modify ho sakte hain. Arrays me sirf position ki value modify kar sakte ho; linked lists me value ke saath next pointer bhi modify kar sakte ho. List truncate karna: aakhri element ka next pointer null kar do. Nodes ki values swap karna: values swap karo, next pointer swap karne ki jaroorat nahi. Do lists combine karna: doosri list ka head pehli list ke tail se attach kar do.

Essential questions

Reverse a Linked List · Detect Cycle in a Linked List

Recommended practice questions

Merge Two Sorted Lists · Merge K Sorted Lists · Remove Nth Node From End Of List · Reorder List

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/linked-list.md

32Algorithms Study Guide

Queue

Queue elements ka linear collection hai jo sequence me maintain kiya jaata hai — elements ek end par add kiye jaate hain (enqueue) aur doosre end se remove kiye jaate hain (dequeue). Jis end par elements add hote hain use back/tail/rear kehte hain, aur jis end se remove hote hain use head/front kehte hain. Abstract data type ke roop me queues arrays ya singly linked lists se implement ki ja sakti hain.

Ye behavior FIFO (first in, first out) kehlata hai — jaise real life me line me khade log. Breadth-first search aam taur par queues se implement ki jaati hai.

Dequeue/PollO(1)
FrontO(1)

Lekin dhyaan rakho: aise scenario me dequeue operation O(n) hoti hai kyunki saare baaki elements ko left shift karna padta hai (front left par ho to). Aise me interviewer ko bata do ki tum assume kar rahe ho ki efficient dequeue wala queue data structure available hai.

Empty queue; ek item wali queue; do items wali queue.

33Algorithms Study Guide

Stack

Stack ek abstract data type hai jo push (stack ke top par naya element insert karna) aur pop (sabse recent add kiya gaya element remove karke return karna) operations support karta hai. Arrays ya singly linked lists se implement kiya ja sakta hai.

Ye behavior LIFO (last in, first out) kehlata hai — jaise ek ke upar ek rakhi hui physical cheezein. Stacks nested ya recursive function calls support karne ka important tareeka hain aur depth-first search implement karne me use hote hain. Depth-first search recursion ya manual stack se implement ki ja sakti hai.

Implementations

LanguageAPI
C++std::stack
Javajava.util.Stack
PythonList se simulate karo
JavaScriptArray se simulate karo

Time complexity

OperationBig-O
Top/PeekO(1)
PushO(1)
PopO(1)
isEmptyO(1)
SearchO(n)

Corner cases

Empty stack — empty stack se pop karna; ek item wala stack; do items wala stack.

34Algorithms Study Guide

Tree

Tree ek widely used abstract data type hai jo hierarchical structure represent karta hai — connected nodes ka set. Har node ke bahut se children ho sakte hain, lekin exactly ek parent hona chahiye — root node ke alawa, jiska koi parent nahi hota. Tree ek undirected aur connected acyclic graph hai — na cycles hote hain na loops. Har node apne subtree ka root ho sakta hai, isliye tree traversal ke liye recursion useful technique hai.

Interviews me aam taur par binary trees poochhe jaate hain (ternary ya N-ary ke bajay). Is page me binary trees aur binary search trees (binary trees ka special case) cover kiye gaye hain. Trees hierarchical data represent karne ke liye use hote hain — jaise file systems, JSON aur HTML documents. Trie section bhi dekho — ye advanced tree hai jo strings store aur search karne ke liye use hota hai.

Upar wale tree ke liye traversals: In-order (Left → Root → Right): 2, 7, 5, 6, 11, 1, 9, 5, 9. Pre-order (Root → Left → Right): 1, 7, 2, 6, 5, 11, 9, 9, 5. Post-order (Left → Right → Root): 2, 5, 11, 6, 7, 5, 9, 9, 1. Dhyaan rakho: binary tree ki in-order traversal akele tree ko uniquely serialize karne ke liye kaafi nahi hai — pre-order ya post-order traversal bhi chahiye hoti hai.

Common terms

  • Neighbor — node ka parent ya child.
  • Ancestor — parent chain se reachable node.
  • Descendant — node ke subtree me node.
  • Degree — node ke children ki sankhya.
  • Degree of a tree — nodes ki maximum degree.
  • Distance — do nodes ke beech shortest path par edges ki sankhya.
  • Level/Depth — node aur root ke beech unique path par edges ki sankhya.
  • Width — ek level me nodes ki sankhya.

Binary tree

Binary matlab do — binary tree ke nodes ke maximum do children hote hain. Complete binary tree — har level (aakhri ke alawa) poori tarah bhara hota hai, aur aakhri level ke saare nodes jitna ho sake left side hote hain. Balanced binary tree — har node ke left aur right subtrees ki height me farq 1 se zyada nahi hota.

Binary search tree (BST)

BST ki in-order traversal saare elements order me de degi. BST ki properties aur binary tree BST hai ya nahi ye validate karna achhe se aana chahiye — ye expected se zyada baar poochha jaata hai. Jab question me BST ho to interviewer aam taur par O(n) se fast solution chahta hai.

OperationBig-O
AccessO(log(n))
SearchO(log(n))
InsertO(log(n))
RemoveO(log(n))

Balanced trees traverse karne ki space complexity O(h) hoti hai (h = height), jabki bahut skewed trees (jo essentially linked list hain) traverse karne me O(n) lagti hai.

Interview me dhyaan rakhne wali baatein

Pre-order, in-order aur post-order traversal recursive tareeke se likhna bahut achhe se aana chahiye. Extension ke roop me iterative tareeke se bhi likhne ki challenge lo — interviewers kabhi-kabhi iterative approach maangte hain, khaas taur par jab candidate recursive approach bahut jaldi likh le.

Corner cases

Empty tree; single node; do nodes; bahut skewed tree (linked list jaisa).

Common routines

Ye routines aani chahiye kyunki bahut se tree questions inme se ek ya zyada use karte hain: value insert karna; value delete karna; tree me nodes ginna; value tree me hai ya nahi check karna; tree ki height calculate karna; BST — BST hai ya nahi determine karna, maximum value nikaalna, minimum value nikaalna.

Techniques

  • Recursion use karo — trees traverse karne ka sabse common approach hai. Jab dikhe ki subtree problem se poora problem solve ho sakta hai, to recursion try karo. Hamesha base case check karna yaad rakho — aam taur par jahan node null ho. Kabhi-kabhi recursive function ko do values return karni padti hain.
  • Level se traverse karna — level-by-level traverse karna ho to breadth-first search use karo.
  • Nodes ka summation — question me raaste me nodes ka sum ho to check karo nodes negative ho sakte hain ya nahi.

Essential questions

Binary Tree: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree · Invert/Flip Binary Tree. Binary Search Tree: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Search Tree.

Recommended practice questions

Binary tree: Same Tree · Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum · Binary Tree Level Order Traversal · Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree · Binary Tree Right Side View · Subtree of Another Tree · Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal · Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree. Binary search tree: Validate Binary Search Tree · Kth Smallest Element in a BST.

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/tree.md
← PehleStackAgla →Graph
35Algorithms Study Guide

Graph

Graph ek structure hai jisme objects (nodes ya vertices) ka set hota hai, jinme edges ho sakte hain. Edges directed ya undirected ho sakte hain aur optionally values bhi ho sakti hain (weighted graph). Trees undirected graphs hote hain jinme kisi bhi do vertices ke beech exactly ek edge hota hai aur koi cycle nahi hota.

Graphs aam taur par unordered entities ke beech relationship model karne ke liye use hote hain — jaise logon ke beech dosti (har node ek person hai, edges dosti dikhate hain), ya locations ke beech distances (har node ek location hai, edge ka value distance hai). Graph representations, graph search algorithms aur unki time/space complexities achhe se aani chahiye.

Graph representations

Edges ki list di ja sakti hai aur tumhe usse apna graph banana hota hai taaki traversal kar sako. Common representations: Adjacency matrix, Adjacency list, Hash table of hash tables. Algorithm interviews me hash table of hash tables sabse simple approach hai; adjacency matrix ya list use karna rare hota hai.

Algorithm interviews me graphs aam taur par 2D matrices ke roop me input me diye jaate hain — cells nodes hote hain aur har cell apne adjacent cells (up/down/left/right) par traverse kar sakta hai. Isliye 2D matrix traverse karna achhe se aana chahiye. Traverse karte waqt hamesha ensure karo ki current position boundary ke andar hai aur pehle visit nahi ki gayi hai.

Time complexity

|V| = vertices ki sankhya, |E| = edges ki sankhya.

AlgorithmBig-O
Depth-first searchO(|V| + |E|)
Breadth-first searchO(|V| + |E|)
Topological sortO(|V| + |E|)

Interview me dhyaan rakhne wali baatein

  • Tree jaisa diagram asal me graph bhi ho sakta hai jisme cycles hon — naive recursive solution kaam nahi karega. Aise me cycles handle karo aur visited nodes ka set rakho.
  • Visited nodes ko sahi tareeke se track karo aur har node ko ek se zyada baar visit mat karo — warna code infinite loop me ja sakta hai.

Corner cases

Empty graph; ek ya do nodes wala graph; disconnected graphs; cycles wala graph.

Graph search algorithms

Common: Breadth-first Search, Depth-first Search. Uncommon: Topological Sort, shortest-path algorithm. Almost never: shortest-path (negative weights), all-pairs shortest-path, minimum-spanning-tree algorithms — interviewer ko bhi shayad ye nahi aate honge.

Depth-first search (DFS)

DFS graph traversal algorithm hai jo har branch me jitna deep ja sakta hai, jaata hai, phir backtrack karta hai. Current search path ke nodes track karne ke liye aam taur par stack use hota hai — implicit recursion stack ya actual stack data structure. Matrix par DFS ka simple template: pehle empty matrix/graph check karo; rows/cols nikaalo; visited set rakho; 4 directions ((0,1), (0,-1), (1,0), (-1,0)); traverse function me visited check karo, add karo, phir neighbors traverse karo (boundary check ke saath); phir har cell se traverse call karo.

Breadth-first search (BFS)

BFS ek node se shuru hota hai aur present depth ke saare nodes explore karta hai, phir agle depth ke nodes par jaata hai. Encounter kiye gaye lekin explore na kiye gaye nodes track karne ke liye queue use hoti hai. Matrix par BFS template DFS jaisa hi hai, lekin queue (double-ended queue — deque) use hoti hai. Arrays/Python lists ko queue ki tarah use mat karo — dequeuing deque me O(1) hoti hai lekin arrays me O(n). DFS recursion se implement hoti hai lekin iterative bhi likhi ja sakti hai; key difference underlying data structure hai (BFS queue use karta hai, DFS stack). Python me deque class stack aur queue dono ki tarah kaam kar sakti hai.

Topological sorting

Directed graph ka topological sort uske vertices ki linear ordering hai — har directed edge uv ke liye (u se v), u ordering me v se pehle aata hai. Matlab har node v tabhi visit hota hai jab uski saari dependencies visit ho chuki hon. Topological sorting sabse zyada jobs/tasks schedule karne me use hoti hai jinme dependencies hon. Jobs vertices hote hain, aur x se y edge hai agar job x, job y se pehle complete honi chahiye. University courses ka example bhi hai — courses ke pre-requisites hote hain. Example: edges do-value tuples ki array hain, pehli value doosri par depend karti hai. graph_topo_sort(4, [[0, 1], [0, 2], [2, 1], [3, 0]]) ka output [1, 2, 0, 3] hota hai.

Essential questions

Number of Islands · Flood Fill · 01 Matrix

Recommended practice questions

Breadth-first search: Rotting Oranges · Minimum Knight Moves (Premium). Either search: Clone Graph · Pacific Atlantic Water Flow · Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph (Premium) · Graph Valid Tree (Premium). Topological sorting: Course Schedule · Alien Dictionary (Premium).

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/graph.md
← PehleTreeAgla →Heap
36Algorithms Study Guide

Heap

Heap ek specialized tree-based data structure hai — complete tree jo heap property satisfy karta hai. Max heap: node ki value uske poore subtree me sabse badi honi chahiye — ye property recursively saare nodes ke liye true honi chahiye. Min heap: node ki value uske poore subtree me sabse chhoti honi chahiye.

Algorithm interviews ke context me heaps aur priority queues ko same data structure mana ja sakta hai. Heap useful hota hai jab baar-baar highest (ya lowest) priority wala object remove karna ho, ya insertions ke beech-beech me root node remove karna ho.

Implementations

LanguageAPI
C++std::priority_queue
Javajava.util.PriorityQueue
Pythonheapq
JavaScriptN/A

Time complexity

OperationBig-O
Find max/minO(1)
InsertO(log(n))
RemoveO(log(n))
Heapify (array se heap banana)O(n)

Techniques — "k" ka mention

Question me top ya lowest k ka mention dikhe to aam taur par signal hai ki heap use ho sakta hai — jaise Top K Frequent Elements. Top k elements chahiye hon to size k ka Min Heap use karo. Har element ko iterate karke heap me push karo (Python heapq me max nikaalna ho to value invert karke push karo). Jab heap ka size k se zyada ho jaaye to minimum element remove kar do — isse guarantee rehti hai ki tumhare paas k largest elements hain.

Essential questions

Merge K Sorted Lists · K Closest Points to Origin

Recommended practice questions

Top K Frequent Elements · Find Median from Data Stream

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/heap.md
← PehleGraphAgla →Trie
37Algorithms Study Guide

Trie

Tries special trees (prefix trees) hain jo strings ko search aur store karna zyada efficient banate hain. Tries ke bahut se practical applications hain — jaise searches karna aur autocomplete dena. In common applications ko jaanna helpful hai taaki aasaani se pehchan sako ki kab problem trie se efficiently solve ho sakti hai.

Scratch se Trie class implement karna aana chahiye, uske add, remove aur search methods ke saath.

Time complexity

m = operation me use hui string ki length.

OperationBig-O
SearchO(m)
InsertO(m)
RemoveO(m)

Corner cases

Empty trie me string search karna; trie me empty strings insert karna.

Techniques

Kabhi-kabhi words ki dictionary (list me di gayi) ko trie me preprocess karne se word search ki efficiency badh jaati hai. Length k wala word, n words me dhoondhna O(k) ho jaata hai, O(n) ke bajay.

Essential questions

Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)

Recommended practice questions

Add and Search Word · Word Break · Word Search II

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/trie.md
← PehleHeapAgla →Interval
38Algorithms Study Guide

Interval

Interval questions array questions ka subset hain — tumhe two-element arrays (interval) ki array di jaati hai, aur do values start aur end value represent karti hain. Interval questions array family ka part hain lekin inme kuch common techniques hoti hain, isliye inke liye alag section hai. Example interval array: [[1, 2], [4, 7]].

Interval questions un logon ko tricky lag sakte hain jinhone pehle try nahi kiye hon — kyunki overlap karne par consider karne ke liye bahut saare cases hote hain.

Interview me dhyaan rakhne wali baatein

  • Interviewer se clarify karo ki [1, 2] aur [2, 3] overlapping intervals mane jaate hain ya nahi — isse tumhare equality checks par farq padega.
  • Clarify karo ki interval [a, b] me hamesha a < b hoga (a, b se chhota hai) ya nahi.

Corner cases

No intervals; single interval; do intervals; non-overlapping intervals; ek interval poori tarah doosre interval ke andar ho; duplicate intervals (bilkul same start aur end); intervals jo wahin se shuru hote hain jahan doosra khatm hota hai — [[1, 2], [2, 3]].

Techniques

  • Intervals ko starting point se sort karo — interval questions ka common routine hai. Ye step Merge Intervals question solve karne ke liye crucial hai.
  • Do intervals overlap karte hain ya nahi, check karo — code likhna aana chahiye: def is_overlap(a, b): return a[0] < b[1] and b[0] < a[1].
  • Do intervals merge karo — def merge_overlapping_intervals(a, b): return [min(a[0], b[0]), max(a[1], b[1])].

Essential questions

Merge Intervals · Insert Interval

Recommended practice questions

Non-overlapping Intervals · Meeting Rooms (Premium) · Meeting Rooms II (Premium)

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/interval.md

39Algorithms Study Guide

Dynamic Programming

Dynamic Programming (DP) aam taur par optimization problems solve karne ke liye use hoti hai. DP me behtar hone ka ek hi tareeka hai — practice. Kuch practice ke baad pehchanne lagoge ki kaunsa problem DP se solve ho sakta hai.

Techniques

Kabhi-kabhi poori DP table memory me store karne ki jaroorat nahi hoti — aakhri do values ya matrix ki aakhri do rows hi kaafi hoti hain.

Handbook ki imandari: DP guide chhota hai — isme sirf introduction, resources aur questions hain. DP ki depth (recurrence relations, memoization vs tabulation, state design) ke liye alag se practice karni hogi; handbook ke practice questions hi shuruaat ke liye kaafi hain.

Essential questions

Climbing Stairs · Coin Change · House Robber · Longest Increasing Subsequence

Recommended practice questions

0/1 Knapsack or Partition Equal Subset Sum · Longest Common Subsequence · Word Break Problem · Combination Sum · House Robber II · Decode Ways · Unique Paths · Jump Game

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/dynamic-programming.md

40Algorithms Study Guide

Binary

Binary number system aur bit manipulation ki knowledge coding interviews me kam important hai, kyunki zyada tar Software Engineers ko bits se deal nahi karna padta — ye lower-level systems aur programming languages me zyada use hota hai. Phir bhi kabhi-kabhi poochha jaata hai, isliye kam se kam decimal se binary (aur vice versa) convert karna apni language me aana chahiye.

Corner cases

Overflow/underflow se aware raho aur check karo; negative numbers.

Techniques — bit manipulation snippets

TechniqueCode
Test k-th bit is setnum & (1 << k) != 0
Set k-th bitnum |= (1 << k)
Turn off k-th bitnum &= ~(1 << k)
Toggle the k-th bitnum ^= (1 << k)
Multiply by 2^knum << k
Divide by 2^knum >> k
Check if a number is a power of 2(num & num - 1) == 0 or (num & (-num)) == num
Swapping two variablesnum1 ^= num2; num2 ^= num1; num1 ^= num2

Essential questions

Sum of Two Integers · Number of 1 Bits

Recommended practice questions

Counting Bits · Missing Number · Reverse Bits · Single Number

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/binary.md
← PehleDynamic ProgrammingAgla →Math
41Algorithms Study Guide

Math

Math Computer Science ka foundational aspect hai aur har programmer ko basic mathematical knowledge chahiye hoti hai. Coding interviews ke liye khush-kismati se zyada math nahi hota, lekin kuch basic math techniques jaanna helpful hai — mathematical operations implement karne ko poochha ja sakta hai.

Interview me dhyaan rakhne wali baatein

  • Code me division ya modulo ho to division/modulo by 0 ka case check karo.
  • Java aur C++ jaise typed languages me overflow/underflow check karo aur handle karo. Kam se kam mention karo ki overflow/underflow possible hai aur poochho ki handle karna hai ya nahi.
  • Negative numbers aur floating point numbers consider karo — interview pressure me obvious cheezein bhi miss ho jaati hain.

Corner cases

Division by 0; multiplication by 1; negative numbers; floats.

Common formulas

Formula
Check if a number is evennum % 2 == 0
Sum of 1 to N1 + 2 + ... + (N - 1) + N = (N+1) * N/2
Sum of Geometric Progression2^0 + 2^1 + 2^2 + 2^3 + ... 2^n = 2^(n+1) - 1
Permutations of NN! / (N-K)!
Combinations of NN! / (K! * (N-K)!)

Techniques

  • Multiples of a number — question me "whether a number is a multiple of X" ho to modulo operator useful hota hai.
  • Comparing floats — floating point numbers se deal karte waqt rounding mistakes ka dhyaan rakho. Equality checks ke bajay epsilon comparisons use karo — jaise abs(x - y) <= 1e-6 instead of x == y.
  • Fast operators — power, square root ya division implement karke O(n) se fast chahiye ho to kisi sort ki doubling (fast exponentiation) ya halving (binary search) approach hoti hai. Examples: Pow(x, n), Sqrt(x).

Essential questions

Pow(x, n) · Sqrt(x)

Recommended practice questions

Integer to English Words

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/math.md
← PehleBinaryAgla →Geometry
42Algorithms Study Guide

Geometry

Geometry mathematics ki branch hai jo distance, shape, size aur figures ki relative position se related properties se deal karti hai. Advanced geometry (jaise 3D geometry) zyada tar Computer Science courses me nahi padhayi jaati, isliye expect karo ki sirf 2D geometry poochhi jaayegi.

Algorithm interviews me geometry aam taur par problem ka focus nahi hoti (tumhe mathematics par evaluate nahi kiya ja raha hai) — aam taur par problem me doosre algorithms aur/ya data structures bhi use karne padte hain.

Corner cases

Zero values — ye hamesha logon ko pakadti hain.

Techniques

  • Do points ke beech distance — distance compare karte waqt dx² + dy² hi kaafi hai; square root karne ki jaroorat nahi hai. Examples: K Closest Points to Origin.
  • Overlapping circles — do circles overlap karte hain ya nahi, ye check karne ke liye dekho ki unke centers ke beech ki distance unke radii ke sum se kam hai ya nahi.
  • Overlapping rectangles — do rectangles overlap karte hain agar ye true ho: overlap = rect_a.left < rect_b.right and rect_a.right > rect_b.left and rect_a.top > rect_b.bottom and rect_a.bottom < rect_b.top. Examples: Rectangle Overlap.

Sample questions

  • Plane par bahut saare rectangles hain, pata karo kitne intersect karte hain.
  • 2D plane par points ke set ke k-nearest points query karne ke liye kaunsa data structure use karoge?
  • Bahut saare points diye gaye hain, origin ke sabse kareeb k points dhoondho.
  • Polygon ko triangulate kaise karoge?

Essential questions

Rectangle Overlap

Recommended practice questions

K Closest Points to Origin · Rectangle Area

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/algorithms/geometry.md

43Algorithms Study Guide

Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

Handbook ka OOP page chhota hai — isme sirf sample questions hain, theory nahi. OOP interviews me aam taur par design questions poochhe jaate hain — classes, objects aur unke relationships design karne hote hain. Neeche handbook ke saare sample questions hain:

Sample questions

  • Chess game kaise design karoge? Kaunsi classes aur objects use karoge? Unke methods kya honge?
  • Library ke liye book keeping system ke data structures kaise design karoge?
  • HTTP server kaise design karoge? Classes, methods aur interfaces ke examples do. Challenges kya hain?
  • Garbage collector ke liye algorithms aur data structures discuss karo.
  • Employee salaries aur benefits track karne ke liye HR system kaise implement karoge?
  • Elevator system kaise implement karoge?
  • Parking Lot system kaise implement karoge?
Imandari se: Handbook ke OOP page me sirf ye 7 sample questions hain — OOP concepts (encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, design patterns) ki theory handbook me nahi hai. In questions ko solve karne ke liye OOP design ki practice alag se karni hogi; System Design Primer SPA ke OOD Problems (Part F) me 6 poore OOD designs code ke saath hain — wahan se practice karo.

44Behavioral Interview

Behavioral Interview Ki Taiyaari — STAR Format

Engineering career me sirf technical skills se kaam nahi chalta — senior hote jaane par people skills aur important ho jaate hain. Senior engineers me lead aur influence karne, conflicts resolve karne, risks anticipate karne aur roadmap plan karne ki ability honi chahiye. Ek talented engineer jo doosron ke saath kaam nahi kar sakta, company ke liye net deficit ho sakta hai — companies aise logon ko hire nahi karna chahti jo poori team ko unproductive kar dein. Behavioral interviews ye determine karne ka tareeka hain ki candidate non-technical standpoint se team ke saath achha kaam karega ya nahi.

Behavioral interview questions aam taur par 3 types ke hote hain: (1) career preferences, ambitions aur plans ke baare me; (2) resume me likhe experiences/projects ki details; (3) "Tell me about a time where you..." type ke questions — jinme certain traits demonstrate kiye hon ya kisi situation par response diya ho.

Behavioral interviews kitne important hain

Companies behavioral skills ko evaluate karti hain. Facebook me 4 me se 1 round behavioral interviews ke liye dedicated hai. Airbnb me 6 me se 2 rounds behavioral/company fit ke liye hain. Lyft me 5 me se 1 round past experience aur situational questions ka hota hai, hiring manager ke saath. Company ke perspective se interview ke do purposes hain: (1) assess karna ki candidate ke paas sahi behaviors demonstrate karne ka history hai jo company me successful banayega; (2) candidate ki seniority assess karna (junior, senior, ya staff).

Behavioral interviews ki importance badhti ja rahi hai kyunki AI zyada code generate kar raha hai. Soft skills — logon ke saath kaise kaam karte ho, communication aur seekhne ki willingness — pivotal hain, kyunki companies engineers se implementation se zyada expect karti hain.

Taiyaari ke 7 steps

  1. STAR answer format seekho
  2. Commonly asked questions ke answers taiyaar karo
  3. Company culture/core values se fit dikhane wale experiences taiyaar karo
  4. Mock behavioral interviews try karo
  5. Structured courses use karo

1. STAR answer format

STAR format behavioral questions ke answers organize karne me madad karta hai — khaas taur par un questions ke liye jinme previous experiences discuss karne hon.

  • Situation — recent challenge aur situation present karo jisme tum the.
  • Task — kya achieve karna tha? Interviewer dekhega tum kya achieve karne ki koshish kar rahe the. Kuch performance methods "Task" ke bajay "Target" use karte hain — khud ka set kiya hua target batane se intrinsic motivation dikhti hai.
  • Action — tumne kya kiya? Interviewer jaanna chahega tumne kya kiya, kyun kiya, aur alternatives kya the.
  • Results — actions ka outcome kya tha? Kya achieve kiya aur kya seekha? Experience ke baad improve karne ke liye kya steps liye?

STAR example — conflict aur influence wala question

Question: "Tell me about a time in which you had a conflict and needed to influence somebody else."

Situation: "Main ek school project ka team lead tha — social network mobile web app banana tha. Hamare designer ke midterms aa rahe the aur mockups banane ka time nahi tha. Front-end person mockups ke liye rush kar raha tha taaki kaam aage badh sake, aur isse designer stress me tha. Team ka atmosphere tense tha."

Task: "Team lead ke roop me mujhe front-end developer aur designer ke beech tension resolve karni thi, taaki team peacefully saath kaam karke project time par complete kar sake."

Action: "Maine front-end developer se baat ki ki wo designer ko mockups ke liye kyun rush kar raha hai. Usne kaha designs jaldi chahiye warna rebuilding me time waste hoga. Maine samjhaya ki midterm dates designer ke control me nahi hain aur ek-doosre ke schedules ko lekar understanding rakhni chahiye. Designer se baat karke rough idea liya aur poochha high-fidelity designs kab tak de sakta hai — usne kaha midterms khatm hote hi shuru kar dega. Maine designer ko samjhaya ki front-end developer ki koi bad intention nahi hai, wo bas project succeed karwana chahta hai. UI/UX design ka thoda experience hone se maine wireframe mocks banaye, designer se approve karwaye, phir front-end developer ko de diye. Maine use placeholders use karne aur details ki chinta na karne ko kaha — non-UI parts pehle banao (authentication, APIs hook up) aur pixels/polish baad me karo. Front-end developer maan gaya."

Result: "Designer ne midterms ke baad beautiful mockups diye jo wireframes me fit ho gaye. Front-end developer ne unhe badi care se implement kiya. Humein project me top marks mile aur hum ek great team ban gaye."

Pro tip: seniority aur growth ka strong signal dikhane ke liye ek additional R — Reflection — add karo. Story ko ye batakar khatm karo ki tumne kya seekha aur kya le gaye. Ye STAR(R) kehlata hai.

2. Apni key stories organize karo

Coding interview se alag, common questions ratna best preparation strategy nahi hai. Tumhe kuch key stories use karni hongi jo bade projects se aati hain — ek project me ambiguity handle karna, conflict resolve karna, communication, etc. sab ho sakta hai. Apne past experiences, resume aur performance reviews dekhkar 3–5 projects collect karo jinme high impact, high complexity aur tumhari high involvement ho.

  • High-Impact Projects: major launches, significant refactors, system migrations, nayi product features, architecture decisions jinhone multiple teams ko affect kiya.
  • Challenging Situations: tight deadlines, technical failures, team/interpersonal conflicts, ambiguous requirements, projects jahan success uncertain thi.
  • Leadership Moments: doosron ko mentor karna, cross-team initiatives drive karna, team ko externally represent karna, times jab doosre tumhari taraf direction ke liye dekhte the.
  • Learning Experiences: galtiyan jinse growth hua, feedback jisne approach badla, skills jo pressure me develop kiye, times jab approach poori tarah rethink karna pada.

Har project ke liye STAR(R) story banao — storytelling ka exercise. Actions par khaas dhyaan do — ye repeatable "behaviors" hain jinke naam par interview hai. Company tumhe wahi project dobaara karne ke liye hire nahi kar rahi, balki un projects par similar behaviors engage karne ke liye kar rahi hai.

3. Big Three Questions taiyaar karo

Specific questions ki taiyaari ki limited value hai, lekin 3 questions bahut common hain — inhe advance me taiyaar karna worth hai:

  • Tell me about yourself — ye question lagbhag har interview kholta hai. Self introduction guide dekho.
  • Tell me about your favorite/most impactful project — wo project chuno jo impact, scope aur tumhari personal involvement ke intersection par ho.
  • Tell me about a time when you resolved a conflict — sabse common soft skill question hai.

Memorize karne ke bajay har question ke bullet points likho aur interviews ke paas verbalize karne ki practice karo — answers zyada natural lagenge.

4. Baaki questions khud se ya AI ke saath practice karo

Big Three ke aage questions anticipate karna mushkil hai, lekin sample questions par storytelling practice karne se bahut value milti hai. Handbook ki 30 questions ki list use karo. Is process se pata chalega ki tumhare story catalog me kahan gaps hain — jaise past mistakes ya leadership moments ke aas-paas stories ki kami ho. Chatbots bhi useful hain: LLM ko prompt karo ki tumse ye questions poochhe aur responses par feedback de, aur follow-up questions bhi poochhe.

5. Company culture/values se fit dikhane wale experiences taiyaar karo

Zyada tar top tech companies apne company values se candidates ko evaluate karti hain. Research karo ki company ke values kya hain aur ensure karo ki tumhare paas fit dikhane wale experiences taiyaar hon.

6. Mock behavioral interviews try karo

Top tech companies ke professional interviewers ke saath behavioral mock interviews schedule karo — interviewing.io par Facebook, Amazon, Apple, Google aur Microsoft ke interviewers milte hain.

7. Newsletters, books aur courses se knowledge badhao

Coding aur system design me bahut achha karne ke baad bhi candidates behavioral round fail karke reject hote dekhe gaye hain. AI zyada code generate karega to behavioral interviews aur important hote jaayenge — senior roles ke liye to hamesha se important the. Free newsletter "Mastering Behavioral Interviews" (Substack) aur uski accompanying book available hain. Courses: "Behavioral Interviews" by Exponent (videos + text, common questions + techniques, behavioral question bank with community responses) aur "Grokking the Behavioral Interview" on Educative (text-based, behavioral interview ke patterns sikhata hai, sirf questions ratna nahi).

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/behavioral-interview.md
← PehleObject-Oriented Programming (OOP)Agla →30 Most Common Behavioral Questions + Company Lists
45Behavioral Interview

30 Most Common Behavioral Questions + Company Lists

Behavioral interviews technical interviews se zyada varied aur unstructured lag sakte hain. Lekin zyada tar cases me interviewer bas tumhe behtar jaanna chahta hai — aur aisa karne ke liye hamesha common questions ka set poochha jaata hai.

Top 30 most common behavioral questions

  1. Why do you want to work for X company?
  2. Why do you want to leave your current/last company?
  3. What are you looking for in your next role?
  4. Tell me about a time when you had a conflict with a co-worker.
  5. Tell me about a time in which you had a conflict and needed to influence somebody else.
  6. What project are you currently working on?
  7. What is the most challenging aspect of your current project?
  8. What was the most difficult bug that you fixed in the past 6 months?
  9. How do you tackle challenges? Name a difficult challenge you faced while working on a project, how you overcame it, and what you learned.
  10. What are you excited about?
  11. What frustrates you?
  12. Imagine it is your first day here at the company. What do you want to work on? What features would you improve on?
  13. What are the most interesting projects you have worked on and how might they be relevant to this company's environment?
  14. Tell me about a time you had a disagreement with your manager.
  15. Talk about a project you are most passionate about, or one where you did your best work.
  16. What does your best day of work look like?
  17. What is something that you had to push for in your previous projects?
  18. What is the most constructive feedback you have received in your career?
  19. What is something you had to persevere at for multiple months?
  20. Tell me about a time you met a tight deadline.
  21. If this were your first annual review with our company, what would I be telling you right now?
  22. Time management has become a necessary factor in productivity. Give an example of a time-management skill you've learned and applied at work.
  23. Tell me about a problem you've had getting along with a work associate.
  24. What aspects of your work are most often criticized?
  25. How have you handled criticism of your work?
  26. What strengths do you think are most important for your job position?
  27. What words would your colleagues use to describe you?
  28. What would you hope to achieve in the first six months after being hired?
  29. Tell me why you will be a good fit for the position.

Airbnb — behavioral questions

Travel karna pasand hai ya Airbnb ki growth appreciate karna achhe answers ho sakte hain, lekin product ke saath deep connection demonstrate karne ki koshish karo. Questions: What does "belong anywhere" mean to you? What large problems in the world would you solve today? Why do you like Airbnb? Unlimited budget ho to ek gift kisko doge aur kya doge? Unlimited budget ho to kahan jaoge? Apni ek trip share karo. Pichhle 6 mahine ka sabse challenging project (school ke andar ya bahar) kya tha? Apni last internship/job se kya nahi chahiye? Kabhi achhe host bane ho — example do. Airbnb experience se kya remove karna chahoge? Kuch naya jo tum interviewer ko kuch minutes me sikha sako. Why do you want to work here? Best gift jo kabhi diya ya receive kiya. Kabhi uncomfortable hue — kaise deal kiya. Recent project explain karo. Airbnb ke baare me kya sochte ho? Apne baare me kuch batao aur kyun good fit ho. Kisi company ki customer service se kabhi impress hue — situation batao. Senior management aur multiple internal teams ke saath bade projects par kaise kaam kiya? Kabhi kisi ko terrible news deni padi — example do. Agar gerbil hote to kaunsa gerbil hote? Company ke baare me kya excite karta hai? Airbnb guests aur hosts ko kaise impact karta hai? Mission ka kaunsa part sabse zyada resonate karta hai?

Amazon — behavioral questions

Failed deadline se kaise deal karte ho? Why Amazon? Teammate ke saath conflict wali situation batao. Kya kabhi manager ki approval ke bina kuch kaam kiya? Koi situation jahan tum kuch alag karte jo tumne actually kiya tha. Sabse badi galti kya ki hai? Human Resources tumhare liye kya matlab rakhta hai? Amazon ki website ko kaise improve karoge?

ByteDance — behavioral questions

Role ke baare me kya jaante ho aur kyun? Koi product start se end tak launch karke dikhao. Pichhle projects me sabse badi achievement kya hai? Recent failure aur usse kya seekha? Why ByteDance? Is position ke liye good fit kyun ho? Role ke baare me kya excite karta hai?

Dropbox — behavioral questions

Apne favorite project ke baare me batao. Hire ho jaao to kya karoge? Koi technical problem solve karne ka experience batao — diagnosis aur process specific rakho.

Hired — behavioral questions

Tell me about yourself. Sabse badi strength aur area of growth kya hai? Is opportunity me interested kyun ho? Salary expectations kya hain? Current company kyun chhodna chahte ho? Kabhi work responsibilities overwhelming hui hon — kya kiya? Team member se difference of opinion hua ho — kaise handle kiya? Recent challenge aur kaise tackle kiya, outcome kya tha? 5 saal me kahan dekhte ho? Kisi se information chahiye thi jo responsive nahi tha — kya kiya?

Lyft — behavioral questions

Ab tak ka sabse interesting/challenging project kya hai? Why Lyft? Agle role me kya dhoondh rahe ho?

Palantir — behavioral questions

Kya hai jisse 90% log tumse disagree karte hain? Tumhare aas-paas kya toota hua hai? Difficult coworkers se kaise deal karte ho — specific instances jahan conflicts resolve kiye. Difficult employees ko kaise jeeta? Koi analytical problem jiss par kaam kiya ho. Tumhari 3 strengths aur 3 weaknesses kya hain? Palantir ke liye projects pick karne ho to kaunsi problem solve karne ki koshish karoge? Current company ki best aur worst cheezein kya hain? Tumhara manager tumhare baare me kya kahega? Palantir ko apni grandmother ko describe karo. Kuch sikhao jo tumne seekha hai. Kabhi kuch predict kiya ho — example do. Supervisors tumhe 1–10 scale par rate karein to kya rate karenge? Sabse fun cheez jo recently ki ho. Apni story batao — kaise wahi bane jo aaj ho aur Palantir ke liye apply kyun kiya.

Slack — behavioral questions

Apni internship ke baare me kuch batao. Slack kyun join karna chahte ho? Past projects ke baare me batao. Sabse tough project aur uski working architecture explain karo. Technical knowledge ke alawa internship me kya seekha? Kisi ka project karne ka viewpoint alag ho (jaise alag programming language) to kaise handle karoge? Sabse interesting subjects kaunse hain aur kyun? Slack me koi bugs mile? Favorite feature kaunsi hai aur kyun?

Stack Overflow — behavioral questions

Kya banaya hai? Sabse mushkil technical problem kya aayi — kaise solve ki? 5 saal me khud ko kahan dekhte ho? Yahan kaam kyun karna chahte ho? Co-workers se disagreements kaise handle karte ho?

Stripe — behavioral questions

Latest technologies se up to date kaise rehte ho? Recent difficult project explain karo. 5 saal me khud ko kahan dekhte ho?

Twitter — behavioral questions

Tumhare previous boss ke hisaab se tumhari sabse badi strength kya thi?

Company-specific questions ke sources: Glassdoor interview pages (handbook me har company ke liye Glassdoor link diya gaya hai).

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/behavioral-interview-questions.md
← PehleBehavioral Interview Ki Taiyaari — STAR FormatAgla →Behavioral Interview Rubrics — 8 Focus Areas
46Behavioral Interview

Behavioral Interview Rubrics — 8 Focus Areas

Technical interviews se alag, behavioral interviews me evaluation criteria me zyada variance hota hai. Lekin zyada tar top tech companies apne company values se candidates ko evaluate karti hain. Interviewers ko ek section bharna hota hai jisme evaluate karna hota hai ki candidate ne company values ke hisaab se behaviors dikhaye ya nahi. Isiliye company ki culture aur values search karo aur ensure karo ki tumhare answers me wo dikhein. Company me kaam karne wale kisi connection se baat karna bhi useful hota hai — pata chalega team me kaunsi values typically valued hain.

8 common focus areas (values)

  • Motivation — tumhe kya drive karta hai? Ideal candidates self-motivated hote hain, technologies aur products ke liye passionate hote hain jinka real impact ho.
  • Ability to be Proactive — initiative le sakte ho? Mushkil problem mile to figure out karke execute kar sakte ho?
  • Ability to work in an unstructured environment — ambiguous situations me ownership le sakte ho? Ya doosron ke batane ka wait karte ho?
  • Perseverance — mushkil problems ya blockers se guzar sakte ho?
  • Conflict Resolution — challenging relationships ko handle karke aage badh sakte ho?
  • Empathy — doosron ke perspective se cheezein dekh sakte ho aur unki motivations samajh sakte ho?
  • Growth — apni strengths, weaknesses aur growth areas samajhte ho? Grow karne ki continued effort kar rahe ho?
  • Communication — interview ke dauraan apni stories clearly communicate kar sakte ho?

In focus areas ko assess karne ke liye interviewers tumhare work history par questions poochhte hain aur situations ki details me jaate hain. Seniority assess karne ke liye har focus area me dekhte hain ki situation ka scope junior, senior ya staff engineer ke liye expected level ka hai ya nahi (details neeche).

Example questions aur responses — har focus area ke liye

Typical interview me 5–6 questions poochhe jaate hain aur har situation ki details me deep dive hota hai. Har question ek se zyada focus areas ke signals de sakta hai.

Motivation

Example questions: kis project par sabse proud ho aur kyun? Recent working day ke baare me batao jo really great aur/ya fun tha. Junior: story jisme project par proud hon, impact team par ho. Senior: story jisme project par proud hon, large impact team par ho. Staff: story jisme project par proud hon, large impact org par ho.

Ability to be proactive

Example questions: kabhi kuch change karna chaaha jo tumhare regular scope se bahar tha? Kabhi fast decision lena pada aur uske results ke saath jeena pada? Junior: change proactively suggest aur drive ki, impact team ke focus area par, aam taur par sirf candidate ko kaam karna pada. Senior: change ka impact poori team par, aam taur par 3+ logon ko kaam karna pada. Staff: change ka impact poori org par, aam taur par 2+ teams ko kaam karna pada.

Ability to work in an unstructured environment

Example questions: agla kaam kya karna hai, ye kaise decide karte ho? Koi project/task jo ambiguous ya underspecified tha, uske baare me batao. Junior: ambiguous task ka ownership liya aur team ke kuch stakeholders se consensus drive kiya, aam taur par sirf candidate ko kaam karna pada. Senior: ambiguous project ka ownership liya aur team/org ke stakeholders se consensus drive kiya, aam taur par 3+ logon ko kaam karna pada. Staff: ambiguous project ka ownership liya aur org ke stakeholders se consensus drive kiya, aam taur par 2+ teams ko kaam karna pada.

Perseverance

Example questions: kabhi external obstacles overcome karke task/project complete karna pada? Kabhi project expected se zyada time le gaya? Junior: task me bahut si technical difficulties, har blocker ko overcome kiya. Senior: project me bahut si technical difficulties jo team ko block kar rahi thi, har blocker ko overcome kiya. Staff: project me bahut si technical difficulties jo bahut si teams ko block kar rahi thi, har blocker ko overcome kiya.

Conflict resolution aur empathy

Example questions: sabse challenging person ya team ke baare me batao. Kabhi coworker se disagree hue? Kabhi do teams kisi path par agree nahi kar paayi hon? Junior: coworker se disagreement ko work through kiya — bade project ke implementation detail par. Senior: kuch coworkers ya team leads se disagreement — bade project ki direction par. Staff: 2+ teams se disagreement — bade project ki direction par.

Growth

Example questions: koi situation jahan galti ki aur usse kya seekha? Manager ya peer se constructive feedback mila ho? Koi skill jo peer/mentor me dekhi aur agle 6 mahine me develop karna chahte ho? Junior: nayi technology seekhna chahte ho aur progress ki hai. Senior: soft skill ya technical skill develop karna chahte ho, progress ki hai — skill jo poori team ko affect kar sakti hai. Staff: soft skill ya technical skill develop karna chahte ho, progress ki hai — skill jo 2+ teams ko affect kar sakti hai.

Communication

Interview ke dauraan generally cover hota hai — stories kitni clearly explain kar rahe ho. Empathy ke saath bhi overlap hai — doosron se kaise communicate karte ho.

Interview ke baad — hire/no-hire decision

Interview ke baad interviewer feedback compile karke hire/no-hire recommendation deta hai, candidate ki seniority ke saath. Hire/no-hire decision ek spectrum par di jaati hai — low confidence se high confidence tak:

Recommendation 8 focus areas par collect kiye gaye signals se compile hoti hai:

  • Junior engineers: hire recommendation tab milti hai jab lagbhag saare 8 focus areas par positive signals hon.
  • Senior engineers: hire recommendation tab milti hai jab lagbhag saare 8 focus areas par positive signals hon AUR senior level par expected level par hon. Warna no-hire recommendation milti hai.
  • Staff engineers: hire recommendation tab milti hai jab lagbhag saare 8 focus areas par positive signals hon AUR staff level par expected level par hon. Warna staff level par no-hire, lekin senior level par hire recommendation mil sakti hai.

Interviewer ka decision final nahi hota. Saara interview feedback collect hone ke baad interviewers "debrief committee" me candidate ki concerns aur strengths discuss karte hain.

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/behavioral-interview-rubrics.md

47Behavioral Interview

Behavioral Interviews — Senior Candidates Ke Liye

Career me aage badhne par behavioral interviews aur critical — aur challenging — ho jaate hain. Junior engineers weak behavioral performance ke saath bhi nikal sakte hain agar coding strong ho, lekin senior roles (Staff+ aur upar) in conversations par depend karte hain. Tumhe organizational impact drive karne, complexity navigate karne aur doosron ko lead karne ki ability ke liye evaluate kiya jaata hai.

Stakes bhi zyada hain — senior hiring mistakes teams bhar me cascade karte hain, isliye interviewers naturally zyada cautious hote hain. Ek Staff Engineer jo cross-team conflicts resolve nahi kar sakta, ya ek Principal jo ambiguous technical decisions se struggle karta hai, poori initiatives derail kar sakta hai.

Senior behaviorals me common pitfalls

  • Structure ki kami se incomplete signal coverage: junior candidates ko interviewer stories se guide karta hai, lekin senior candidates se expect kiya jaata hai ki wo proactively apna scope demonstrate karein. Problem tab badh jaati hai jab interviewers interrupt karte hain ya rabbit holes me jaate hain — senior level par ye aam hai. Senior candidate ko conversation ko sabse relevant signal ki taraf guide karna hota hai — matlab wo signal pehle se pata hona chahiye.
  • Leadership ka full spectrum neglect karna: senior roles me multiple dimensions me influence chahiye hota hai, lekin candidates aksar sirf ek perspective se stories batate hain. Aksar stories sirf technical decisions ya product outcomes par hoti hain — people leadership, risk/capacity/change management, strategy work aur stakeholder management miss ho jaate hain.
  • Actions batana, frameworks chhod dena: senior candidates ko systematic thinking dikhani chahiye — decision-making framework jo actions tak le gaya. Sirf actions list karne se executor lagte ho, strategic thinker nahi — aur misinterpretation ka scope khul jaata hai.
  • Verbosity: communication in roles me central hai, isliye zyada bolna aasaan habit hai. Limited time me bahut kuch cover karna hota hai — interviewer jo signal maang raha hai, usi ke hisaab se adapt karo aur sirf relevant context do.
  • Uncharitable interpretations ke liye khud ko khol dena: senior candidates zyada scrutiny face karte hain — stories ya individual actions jo junior candidates ke liye acceptable hon, senior level par red flags utha sakte hain. Iske liye defensively sochna padta hai ki stories kaise interpret ho sakti hain.

Story selection — pure technical impact se aage

Senior level par project stories ko multifaceted leadership dikhani chahiye jo modern engineering work ke full spectrum ko cover kare.

Leadership complexity wale projects chuno: multiple teams, ambiguous requirements aur/ya significant technical risk wale initiatives dhoondho. Full leadership spectrum demonstrate karo — stories me 4 key dimensions ke evidence hone chahiye:

  • Technical leadership: architecture decisions, technology choices, technical debt management.
  • People leadership: mentoring, conflict resolution, team building, hiring aur performance management.
  • Process aur operational leadership: engineering practices establish karna, incident response, capacity planning.
  • Strategic aur business leadership: roadmap planning, stakeholder management, resource allocation.

Story organization aur delivery — narrative complexity manage karna

Senior-level projects inherently complex hote hain — aksar months ya years tak chalte hain, multiple workstreams aur stakeholders ke saath. Stories lambi hoti hain, isliye traditional STAR formatting complexity capture karne me fail ho jaata hai.

  • "Table of Contents" approach use karo: major themes ya phases ka brief overview dekar shuru karo. Example: "Is migration ke 3 critical parts the: technical architecture decisions, 5 teams me organizational change manage karna, aur transition ke dauraan customer communication handle karna."
  • Impact ko front-load karo: results ko ant me mat chhupao. Senior interviewers interrupt karke detailed follow-ups poochh sakte hain, aur tum conclusion tak kabhi pahunch hi na pao. Results ko Situation section me hi include karo — business impact ke saath — phir explain karo kaise achieve kiya.
  • Interruptions ke liye taiyaar raho: senior behavioral interviews conversational bhi hote hain aur impatient bhi. Interviewers decision-making processes me deep dive karenge, alternatives poochhenge, ya team dynamics ke specific aspects explore karenge. Modular story components taiyaar rakho jinhe expand ya condense kar sako. Follow-up question khatm karke interviewer ko agle theme par wapas le aao taaki apne accomplishments par signal deliver karte raho.
  • Scope dikhane wale details add karo: har detail ka koi purpose hona chahiye — technical complexity, organizational challenge ya strategic thinking dikhana. "12 engineers across 4 time zones coordinate karna" scope signal karta hai. "500M+ daily transactions zero downtime ke saath migrate karna" technical aur business impact dono dikhata hai.
  • Redundant takeaways wale details chhodo: agar kisi project ki teesri challenging technical situation ko gory detail me bata rahe ho, to wahi message repeat kar rahe ho — "main technical hoon" — jabki us time ka use career ke doosre aspects establish karne me kar sakte the.
  • Audience ko jaano: is level ke interviewers kam systematic structure aur zyada variance ke saath operate kar sakte hain, ya XFN partners interview le sakte hain. Dhyaan do wo kya probe kar rahe hain aur stories adjust karo — VP ko business impact aur organizational alignment zyada matter karega, PM non-technical partners ke baare me poochhega, Principal Engineer technical decision-making frameworks me deep dive karega.
  • Interviewer ko observe karo aur respond karo: story batate waqt listener ki engagement dekho aur detail ka level adjust karo. Agar wo baar-baar elaboration maang rahe hain, to up front detail do. Agar unhone kuch der se kuch likha nahi hai, to socho ki relevant actions share kar rahe ho ya nahi, aur story ke agle part par chalo.

Defensively sochna

Behavioral interviewers 45–60 minutes me subjective judgments banate hain — aksar lines ke beech padhkar aur conclusions par jump karke. Senior interviewers, hiring mistakes dekh chuke hote hain, naturally cautious hote hain — khaas taur par leadership roles ke liye jahan problematic hire poori organization me cascade kar sakta hai. Tumhare actions "galat" na bhi hon, to bhi uncharitable interpretations ke liye khule reh sakte ho. Narrative me jo gaps hain, wo assumptions se bhar diye jaate hain — jo tumhare favor me nahi bhi ho sakte.

Common problematic framings

  • Passive ownership: "Main sprint meeting me aaya aur manager ne mujhe ye ticket assign kiya..." — weak ownership aur junior-level thinking signal karta hai, business-focused initiative ke bajay.
  • Proactivity ki kami: "Codebase me test coverage nahi thi isliye time lag gaya..." ya "Executive ke paas visibility nahi thi isliye under-resourced tha..." — suggest karta hai ki problems notice karte ho lekin solutions drive nahi karte.
  • Ambiguity persist karne dena: "Stakeholders ki alag opinions thi, isliye humne kai alignment meetings schedule ki..." — weak decision-making dikhata hai, uncertainty se drive karne ke bajay.
  • One-way communication: "Team ne API changes wiki me document kar diye, lekin kuch teams ko phir bhi integration issues hue..." — communication ko broadcast mana, understanding ensure karne ke bajay.

Weak spots identify karna

Mock interviewers se story weaknesses spot karwao jo tum khud nahi dekh sakte. Weaknesses ke baare me journal karke apni stories review karo. Follow-up questions par suspicious raho — wo aksar perceived weaknesses ko target karte hain.

Defensive strategies

  • Problematic parts elide karo: "Manager ne ticket assign kiya" ke bajay kaho "Main sprint meeting se is high-impact task ke saath nikla..."
  • Unavoidable issues ko proactively frame karo: rationale explain karo. Stakeholder alignment example ke liye: "Humne extensively strategize kiya aur clear position ke saath aaye, lekin executives strategic direction par at odds the. Maine realize kiya ye product decision nahi, business question hai, isliye user engagement aur revenue impact par data taiyaar kiya, phir concrete evidence ke saath decision-making session facilitate karke strategic conflict resolve kiya."
  • Mistakes ko learning ke saath acknowledge karo: "Team ne changes wiki me document kiye, lekin kuch teams ko integration issues hue. Maine realize kiya hum coordination ke bina launch karne me hasty the. Maine process me changes lead kiye — tech lead planning docs me Change Management add kare, future ke liye."
Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/behavioral-interview-senior-candidates.md
