48Resume, Intro & Final Questions

FAANG-Ready Resume Kaise Likhein

Top tech companies me shortlist nahi ho pa rahe ho? Tumhara software engineer resume issue ho sakta hai. FAANG interviewer ke roop me tons of resumes padhne ke baad ye dekha gaya hai ki sabse qualified candidates bhi bure resumes ki wajah se shortlist nahi hote. Zyada tar log turant assume kar lete hain ki wo qualified nahi the — lekin asal me aisa ho sakta hai hi nahi.

Achha resume likhne ke specific steps aur requirements hain — resume structure, content, aur free tools jinse resume test kar sakte ho. 4 steps: (1) ATS-friendly resume template setup karo; (2) template ko well-framed content se meaningful order me bharo; (3) prioritization aur keywords se resume optimize karo; (4) free tools se resume test karo.

ATS-friendly resume kaise setup karo

Zyada tar top tech companies kisi na kisi form ka Applicant Tracking System (ATS) use karti hain — hazaaron resumes ko human eyes tak pahunchne se pehle parse aur screen karne ke liye. Kuch companies me ATS certain rules se candidates ko automatically reject bhi kar deta hai. Alag companies alag ATS use kar sakti hain, lekin apne resume ko zyada tar ATS ke liye favorably readable banana possible hai.

Sirf Microsoft Word ya Google Docs use karo

Do's: resume PDF file ke roop me submit karo taaki formatting preserve rahe, lekin hamesha Microsoft Word ya Google Docs se banao. Ensure karo ki resume ka text easily highlightable ho — easy parsing ki precondition hai. ATS tools standard resume formats ki readability improve karte rehte hain — isliye format jitna commonplace ho, utna behtar. Space maximize karne ke liye header/footer use karne ke bajay page ke margins kam karo — narrow margins har side 0.5 hote hain.

Don'ts: Photoshop, doosre graphic design tools ya online resume builders se resume mat banao. Word/Google Docs file me header ya footer sections use mat karo — margins kam karo aur information body me hi likho.

Sirf standard fonts, readable sizes

Naye fonts letters ko special characters me convert kar sakte hain jo ATS padh nahi sakta. Fonts jo use karne chahiye: Arial, Calibri, Garamond. Font size humans ke liye readable rakho — minimum 10 pt use karo.

Standard headings aur ordering wale sections add karo

ATS readers ko resume se standard types ki information identify aur parse karni hoti hai. Standard header titles aur ordering se ye aasaan hota hai. Recommended order:

SectionHeading Name
Professional summaryResume headline ko section title ki tarah use karo, jaise "Senior Software Engineer at Google with over 5 years of experience leading teams"
Contact information"Contact Information"
Skills — programming languages, frameworks, etc."Skills"
Experience"Work Experience"
Education (school me ho ya 3 saal se kam experience ho to Education pehle rakh sakte ho)"Education"
Projects"Projects"
Doosre optional sections — Certifications, Awards, etc."Awards and Accolades" / "Certifications" / "Awards, Accolades and Certifications"

Caution: headers me symbols kabhi mat add karo — ATS readability issues aate hain.

Achha resume content kaise likho

Professional summary

Achha professional summary game changer ho sakta hai — poore professional experience ko summarize karta hai aur hiring manager par pleasant impression chhodta hai. Interviewers ke paas detail padhne ka time nahi hota, isliye summaries jo seedha batayein ki candidate job ke liye good fit kyun hai, attention capture karne ke chances badhati hain.

Pehle: apne poore experience se best selling points list karo jo job descriptions fulfill karte hon — job experiences ya skills. Phir: selling points ko 50 words se kam ke short summary me frame karo. Ensure karo: ✅ job ke liye good fit kyun ho, ye answer karo; ✅ active voice use karo; ✅ action words use karo; ✅ job role describe karne wale noun se shuru karo (jaise "Software Engineer", "Front End Engineer").

Headline likho: "Professional Summary" likhne ke bajay apne experience ko 10 words se kam ki headline me concise karo — LinkedIn profile headline ka thoda elaborate version. Examples:

  • Software Engineer (Full Stack): X saal ke full stack web development experience wale Software Engineer, Ruby on Rails aur PostgreSQL me specialize karte hain. Multiple e-commerce companies me kaam karke e-commerce aur payments field ke domain expert hain.
  • Senior Front End Engineer: X saal ke experience wale Front End Engineer, Front End technologies me strong fundamentals. Scalable web infrastructure banana aur websites fast karna pasand hai. Programming languages, compilers aur developer tooling me passionate hain.
  • Software Engineering Lead: X saal ke experience wale Software Engineer — back end, complex distributed systems scale karna, aur various cloud platforms. 2 companies me average size 6 members wali 5+ engineering teams lead ki, 20+ junior members mentor kiye.
  • Senior at University X: University X me Senior Year student, Artificial Intelligence aur Machine Learning (ML) par focus. X companies me intern kiya, full stack development aur ML engineering roles par kaam kiya.

Contact information

Must-haves: Name (resume ke bilkul top par); personal phone number (work phone kabhi mat do); Location — City, State, Zip (recruiters ko pata chale local ho ya international candidate); Email address (work email kabhi mat do; doosri services use kar rahe ho to Gmail recommend hai); LinkedIn profile. Good-to-haves: GitHub profile URL; personal website URL; Stack Overflow profile URL; Medium profile URL; competitive coding profile (CodeChef, HackerRank). Information ke beech divider chahiye ho to "|" ya tabs use karo. Coding platforms par achievements ho to indicate karo — max ratings, ranking, stars, badges.

Skills

Programming languages aur tech stacks include karo, is structure me: [Skill summary] : [List skills separated by "|"]. Programming languages — impressive ho to familiarity lines ki sankhya se dikhao, jaise "Over 10,000 lines". Frameworks aur Databases bhi include karo.

Work experience

Reverse chronological order me list karo. Har job me hona chahiye: company, location, title, duration — is structure me: [Company or Organization], [Location] | [Job Title] | [Start and end dates MM/YYYY]. Example: Facebook, Singapore | Front End Engineering Lead | 08/2018 - Present. Top accomplishments list karo: job ki scope aur required skills; accomplishments is structure me: [Accomplishment summary] : [Action] that resulted in [quantifiable outcome].

Education

Zyada tar software engineering jobs ke liye kam se kam undergraduate degree chahiye hoti hai. Recent graduate ho ya zyada work experience na ho, tabhi education ko work experience se upar priority do. Format: [Degree Name], [Year of Graduation] / [University Name], [Location] / GPA: X.XX / 4.0 (GPA list karo agar 3.50/4.00 se zyada ho, ya 5-point system me 4.3 se zyada) / key achievements — leadership positions, skills, societies, projects, awards. Example: BSc in Computing, Computer Science, Graduation Year 2015; National University of Singapore, Singapore; GPA: 3.82 / 4.00 (Magna cum laude); Dean's List, Valedictorian; President of hacker society.

Projects

Kam se kam 2 projects include karo jinme contribute kiya ho, key contributions outline karte hue. Project name ko GitHub ya kahin link karo jahan hiring manager project dekh sake. Example: facebook/docusaurus — Maintainer aur lead engineer, Docusaurus v2 (static site generator jo Meta ke Open Source Projects — React Native, Jest, Relay, Reason, etc. ki documentation power karta hai; GitHub par 7.6k+ projects use karte hain).

Awards, accolades aur certifications

Sirf job application se related achievements include karo aur quantify karne ki koshish karo. Format: [Year] [Quantification] [Competition]. Example: 2016 | Best All-Round Product out of 50 teams | Facebook Hackathon.

Resume ko keywords se optimize karo

Less is more

Do's: kuch best achievements highlight karna bahut saare "average" achievements list karne se behtar hai; resume sirf 1 page ka rakho. Don'ts: quantity dikhane ke liye saare achievements filter kiye bina list mat karo.

Keyword optimization

Hiring manager ya recruiter resume ko quickly scan karke un skills/experiences ke keywords dhoondhta hai jinhe wo value karta hai — detail padhne se pehle. Recruiters aur ATS bhi wahi karte hain, lekin job description ke basis par. Isliye job descriptions ke hisaab se resume optimize karna bahut important hai. Kuch ATS skills ki strength keyword ki frequency se determine karte hain, aur kuch skill ka estimated experience uski placement se assign karte hain — jaise pichhli job 3 saal ki thi aur tumne Search engine marketing (SEM) handle karna mention kiya, to ATS 5 saal ka SEM experience assume kar lega.

Job descriptions ke keywords include karo: job description analyze karo — must-have aur good-to-have skills/experiences — aur ensure karo keywords resume me hon. "Skills" section me include karo aur wahi keywords "Work Experience" aur "Education" sections me bhi daalo. Job description ki language ko closely imitate karo. Common abbreviations ka full version bhi include karo — jaise AWS ke bajay Amazon Web Services, GCP ke bajay Google Cloud Platform. Lekin keyword stuffing mat karo — resume ant me recruiter ya hiring manager padhega.

Keyword frequency aur placement optimize karo: job description analyze karke har skill/experience ki importance determine karo, phir us hisaab se keyword ki frequency optimize karo. Tip: har application ke liye optimize karna ideal hai, lekin ek type ki position ke liye generalize kar sakte ho — us position ki 3–5 job descriptions collect karo, .txt file me copy-paste karke free "word and phrase" frequency tool (jaise Online-Utility.org Text Analyzer) me daalo, regularly used keywords identify karo, aur apne skills/experiences ko resume me incorporate karo.

Resume review karne ke tools

  • Resume review: FAANG Tech Leads ki resume review service — ex-FAANG hiring managers aur engineers se review karwao. Unke resume handbook pages (professional summary, contact information, skills, work experience, education, projects) bhi useful hain.
  • ATS readability test: Resume Worded ya AI Resume Judge jaise free tools se resume ki readability aur formatting test karo. Targeted Resume ya Resume Shortlister se check karo ki resume job requirement ke liye kitna achha hai — improvement tips aur add karne layak keywords ki list milti hai.
  • Plain text file test: resume ka content copy karke plain text document me paste karo. Edit karo agar: original resume se points missing hon; characters plain text me galat display ho rahe hon; sections disorganized hon.

Perfect cover letter likhna

Cover letter ek handshake hai — resume me encapsulated professional persona ka introduction. Ye genuine interest express karne ka avenue hai — position ya company ke liye, aur value dikhane ka jo tum add kar sakte ho. Resume ke formal tone se alag, cover letter unique, creative expression ki permission deta hai — ensure karo ki ye resume ko complement kare, replicate na kare.

Tailoring key hai. Skills aur aspirations ko role se align karo — sirf naam switch karne se aage badho. Company ethos, industry aur specific role me delve karo, taaki cover letter clear understanding aur deliberate choice reflect kare. Dikhana hoga ki research ki hai aur company mission samajhte ho, aur kaise contribute karoge.

Structure: Capture Attention — opening paragraph me succinctly batao ki tum ideal candidate kyun ho. Express Your Value — kya laate ho, company goals me kaise contribute kar sakte ho. Narrate Succinctly — log stories se resonate karte hain; brief, relevant narrative share karo jo reader ko intrigued chhode. Resume ki tarah cover letter bhi bahut rare hi one page se zyada hona chahiye.

Common pitfalls: Generic Trap — har job/company ke liye tailor karo, one-size-fits-all mat use karo. Repetition — cover letter resume ko accentuate kare, echo na kare. Over-verbosity — crisp aur to-the-point rakho, ek page se kam. Sloppiness — spelling/grammar errors attention to detail ki kami dikhate hain; meticulously proofread karo.

Practical tips: qualifications ko employer ki needs se align karo; engaging rakho; cliches aur standard phrases avoid karo — pehla paragraph employer ka attention capture karna chahiye; errors se free rakho — dost se review karwao ya side me rakhkar fresh eyes se dobaara padho.

Cover letter example aur evaluation (ML Engineer)

Paragraph 1: The Hook aur personal touch — Argentina me bade hote hue economics ke questions roz-marra ki zindagi ka part hote hain — developing countries natural disasters ya geopolitical conflicts ke consequences suffer karte hain, lekin generations of Argentines ne macroeconomic imbalances ki wajah se hue crisis ke consequences se bachne me poori zindagi bita di hai. Is history ki wajah se ek din bhi aisa nahi guzarta jab koi dost ya family member peso-dollar exchange rate ya Central Bank ko inflation kam karne ke liye kya karna chahiye, is par prediction na de raha ho.

Paragraph 2: Motivation, background aur growth story — in daily questions ka jawab dhoondhne ki curiosity ne University of Buenos Aires me Economics me Degree shuru karwayi. Poori university career financial institution me kaam karte hue ki — 8 saal — exhausting aur challenging, dono. In 8 saalon me dekha ki new technologies aur Big Data tools corporate decisions lene ka tareeka kaise transform kar rahe hain. Isi curiosity ne Machine Learning techniques me interest jagaya, isliye Madrid me Master in Big Data kiya. Phir recruiter ne London me gaming industry me skills unleash karne ka opportunity diya.

Paragraph 3: Achievements, impact aur stakeholder management — Gaming company ne incredible opportunity diya: pehli baar childhood memories (gamer hone ke) ko professional skills se connect kar paaya. Capable leadership ne project management aur analytical skills pehchan kar badi responsibilities di. Chief Strategy Officer aur Head of External Developer Relations ke saath closely kaam karke publishing aur M&A opportunities identify ki. Unki watch me 2 strategic deals close hue jo ab portfolio revenue ka 10% se zyada contribute karte hain. Phir ek chhoti SaaS mobile data company join ki — hard decision thi, lekin start-up ko globally grow karne me help karna aisa opportunity tha jo decline nahi kar sakta tha.

Paragraph 4: Company join karne ki motivation, personal values se aligned — SaaS company ke baad Fintech industry me apply karne ka mauka mila. Argentina se aakar, jahan log achhe credit na hone ke consequences suffer karte hain, UK aur US me free-credit democratize karne wale mission ko lekar extremely excited tha.

Final tips

  • Job application forms ko lightly mat lo — company "Work Experience" aur "Education" sections apne form me bharne ko kahe to lightly mat lo. Ye internal HR applications hain jo applications parse aur filter karte hain. Ho sakta hai recruiter ya hiring manager tumhara resume kabhi dekhe hi nahi — sirf form me bhari hui information dekhe.
  • Ek hi company me bahut saari jobs ke liye apply mat karo — ATS se recruiters dekh sakte hain ki tumne company me kitne roles ke liye apply kiya hai. Bahut saare roles ke liye apply karne se recruiter samajh nahi paata ki tum actually interested ho ya self-aware ho. Example: ek hi company me Software Engineer aur Data Scientist dono roles ke liye apply karna achha idea nahi hai.
Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/resume.md
← PehleBehavioral Interviews — Senior Candidates Ke LiyeAgla →Perfect Self Introduction Kaise Banayein
49Resume, Intro & Final Questions

Perfect Self Introduction Kaise Banayein

"Tell me about yourself" ya "give me a quick introduction of your profile" — lagbhag har software engineer interview ka pehla question hota hai. Ye guide sikhata hai ki perfect self introduction craft karke interviewer ko kaise impress karo.

Interviewers un candidates ke saath kaam karna chahte hain jinhe wo pasand karte hain. Achha/deep impression chhodo to success ke chances badh jaate hain. Self introductions hum sab ko aate hain — naye logon se milte waqt introduce karna padta hai. Lekin interviews me self introduction real life se thoda alag hota hai — apne advantage ke liye tweak karna padta hai: self introduction ko role aur company ke hisaab se tailor karo. Tumhara self introduction evolve hota hai jaise tum grow karte ho aur career ke alag stage par hote ho.

"Tell me about yourself" ko is tarah rephrase kar sakte ho: "Tell me about your journey into tech. How did you get interested in coding, and why was web development (ya doosri job-specific skills) a good fit for you? How is that applicable to our role or company goals?" Job se irrelevant cheezon par valuable time spend karna achha idea nahi hai.

Elevator pitch banao

"Elevator pitch" ek journalist se originate hua jo editor ko idea pitch karna chahti thi — editor ko pakadne ka ek hi time elevator me tha, aur uske paas sirf lagbhag 30 seconds the. Elevator pitch ke key elements: Short (limited time hai), Direct (limited time me point par aao), Attention-grabbing (sabse attractive ideas present karo).

Job fair me sauon candidates ke beech limited time ho ya potential connection/client ko khud explain karna ho — apna knowledge aur skills quickly aur succinctly describe karna important hai. Tumhara self introduction tumhare liye elevator pitch hai.

Elevator pitch banane ke tips

1. Basic background information se shuru karo

Kaun ho, kahan kaam karte ho (ya school aur major), aur kya karte ho — ye include karo. Internships: naam, school aur major, focus areas, past internships aur/ya noteworthy projects mention karo. Full-time: naam, past companies, noteworthy projects (best ho agar public consumer product ho jise unhone suna ho) mention karo.

Ye familiar lagna chahiye — ye tumhare resume jaisa hi hai. Resume tumhare knowledge aur experiences ka condensed version hai, aur self introduction tumhare resume ka condensed version hai. Jaise senior hote jaate ho, professional experience zyada important aur school background kam important ho jaata hai — isliye self introduction senior hote hi change hota hai.

2. KISS (Keep It Simple and Sweet)

Favorite/sabse impressive projects ke highlights batao, numbers include karo agar impressive hon ya challenges overcome kiye hon. Depth me mat jao ki game ko reverse engineer karke packet decrypt karke predict kiya kab DKP use karna hai. Executive summary batao: "Maine X game ko Y packet decrypt karke Z predict karne ke liye reverse engineer kiya." Agar interest aaya to wo khud aur poochhenge.

History lesson avoid karo — "Maine 13 saal ki umar me coding shuru ki, State U college gaya, BigCo me intern kiya, college ke baad SmallCo me front-end job li, phir Acme me backend par gaya..." — ye listener ko value nahi deta. Past me wo roles include karo jo meaningful hon aur jinse koi takeaway ho. History lesson ke bajay try karo: "Mere roles badi aur chhoti companies me rahe hain, aur maine stack bhar me kaam kiya hai."

3. Why do they want you?

Interviewer ko batao tum good hire kyun banoge. Kya tumhara experience company ke liye relevant hai? Kya tumne company jaisa tech stack use kiya hai ya relevant products banaye hain? Tumhare paas kaunse unique talent hain jo unhe confidence dein ki tum company me contribute kar sakte ho?

4. Practice karo

Pitch ko practice karna hi hoga. Great, succinct summary tabhi help karta hai jab tum use rapidly deliver kar pao. Quick lekin easy-to-follow pace practice karo — overwhelm bhi na karo aur bore bhi na karo. Ye precarious balance hai, lekin practice se iron out ho jaata hai.

Self introduction banane ke baad use kahin save kar lo jahan refer/tweak kar sako. Memorize karo aur future me jab chahiye ho use karo — lekin aisa mat lago jaise memory se recall kar rahe ho. Natural lago.

Haath me elevator pitch hona network banane aur naye job opportunities paane ka great tareeka hai. Aksar aise times aate hain jab interview ya meeting ke liye prepare nahi kar paate — practiced pitch incredibly handy hoti hai.

Good examples — Software Engineer self introductions

Example 1: Front End Engineer, Meta

Self introduction: "Hi I'm XXX, maine 2015 me National University of Singapore se Computer Science me degree li. Meri interests Front End Engineering me hain aur mujhe beautiful aur performant products banana pasand hai, delightful user experiences ke saath. School me maine ek web application design aur build kiya, NUSMods — jo har semester class aur timetable planning ki badi problem solve karta hai. Ise mahine me 1 million se zyada pageviews milte hain aur 40,000 se zyada NUS students aur kuch professors use karte hain. Ye modern web technology stack par bana hai — React, Redux, Jest, Babel, Flow, webpack — aur mobile-responsive hai. Main Meta me Front End Engineer role me interested hoon kyunki main Meta ki Open Source Front End technologies kuch time se use kar raha hoon aur Meta ke mission aur Open Source culture se inspired hoon."

Breakdown: "I love to create beautiful and performant products with delightful user experiences" — Front End engineer me hone wali qualities. "Mahine me 1 million se zyada pageviews aur 40,000+ NUS undergraduates aur kuch professors use karte hain" — project ke baare me standout cheez. "Modern web technology stack — React, Redux, Jest, Babel, Flow, webpack, mobile-responsive" — Meta tech stack! Aur hint deta hai ki modern web technologies se updated rehte ho.

Example 2: Front End Engineer, Lyft

Self introduction: "Hi I'm XXX, maine 2015 me National University of Singapore se Computer Science me degree li. Meri interests Front End Engineering me hain aur mujhe beautiful performant products banana pasand hai, delightful user experiences ke saath. Main pehle Grab me kaam karta tha, jahan maine Grab for Work project lead kiya. Grab for Work companies ke liye service thi jisse corporate transportation expenses convenient ho jaayein — companies employee groups bana sakti hain, ride policies set kar sakti hain aur corporate payment methods share kar sakti hain. Maine project ek aur engineer ke saath 3 mahine me React/Redux aur Golang stack par banaya. Main Lyft me Front End Engineer role me interested hoon kyunki mujhe ridesharing space pasand hai aur users ki zindagi improve karne wale products banana pasand hai."

Breakdown: "I love to create beautiful and performant products with delightful user experiences" — wahi, Front End engineer qualities. "Maine Grab me Grab for Work project lead kiya" — Lyft Grab ki sister company thi, dono ke beech partnership bhi thi — zyada tar Lyft engineers ne Grab ke baare me suna hoga, mention karna attention pakadta hai. "Maine project ek aur engineer ke saath 3 mahine me React/Redux aur Golang stack par banaya" — acknowledge karta hai ki doosron ke saath kaam kiya; 2 logon se 3 mahine me non-trivial system banana bahut achha hai; Lyft bhi high performance systems ke liye Golang use karta hai.

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/self-introduction.md
← PehleFAANG-Ready Resume Kaise LikheinAgla →Interview Ke Ant Me Poochhne Wale Best Questions
50Resume, Intro & Final Questions

Interview Ke Ant Me Poochhne Wale Best Questions

Ek cheez jo har Software Engineer interview ke ant me hamesha hoti hai — technical aur non-technical dono rounds me — interviewer poochhta hai "have any final questions?" Ye asal me question hi nahi hai — candidates se questions expect kiye jaate hain. Interviewer ke roop me, jin candidates ke paas koi questions nahi hote, wo role me kam interested lag sakte hain.

Iske alawa tumhare questions batate hain ki tumhe kis cheez ki parwah hai. Achhe tareeke se poochhe jaayein to ye predictable opportunity hai achhi impression chhodne ki, aur role ke baare me aur jaanne ki (potential red flags uncover karne samet). Neeche har purpose ke liye questions hain. Bold wale questions interviewer ko "That's a good question" kehkar pause karke sochne par majboor kar dete hain.

Technical work ke baare me jaanne ke liye

  • What are the engineering challenges that the company/team is facing?
  • What has been the worst technical blunder that has happened in the recent past? How did you guys deal with it? What changes were implemented afterwards to make sure it didn't happen again?
  • What is the most costly technical decision made early on that the company is living with now?
  • What is the most fulfilling/exciting/technically complex project that you've worked on here so far?
  • I do/don't have experience in domain X. How important is this for me to be able to succeed?
  • How do you evaluate new technologies? Who makes the final decisions?
  • How do you know what to work on each day?
  • How would you describe your engineering culture?
  • How has your role changed since joining the company?
  • What is your stack? What is the rationale for/story behind this specific stack?
  • Do you tend to roll your own solutions more often or rely on third party tools? What's the rationale in a specific case?
  • How does the engineering team balance resources between feature requests and engineering maintenance?
  • What do you measure? What are your most important product metrics?
  • How often have you moved teams? What made you join the team you're on right now? If you wanted to move teams, what would need to happen?
  • What resources does the company have for new hires to study its product and processes? Are there specifications, requirements, documentation?
  • How do you think my expertise would be relevant to this team? What unique value can I add?

Role ke baare me jaanne ke liye

  • What qualities do you look out for when hiring for this role?
  • What would be the most important problem you would want me to solve if I joined your team?
  • What does a typical day look like in this role?
  • What are the strengths and weaknesses of the current team? What is being done to improve upon the weaknesses?
  • What resources does the company have for new hires to study its product and processes? Are there specifications, requirements, documentation?
  • What would I work on if I joined this team and who would I work most closely with?

Culture aur welfare ke baare me jaanne ke liye

  • What is the most frustrating part about working here?
  • What is unique about working at this company that you have not experienced elsewhere?
  • What is something you wish were different about your job?
  • How is individual performance measured?
  • What do you like about working here?
  • What is your policy on working from home/remotely?
  • What does the company do to nurture and train its employees?
  • Does the company culture encourage entrepreneurship and creativity? Could you give me any specific examples?

Team leadership ya management ke baare me jaanne ke liye

Ye questions Engineering Managers ya senior level management (CEO, CTO, VPs) se poochhne ke liye suitable hain — khaas taur par Google interviews ke Team Matching phase ya post-offer calls ke liye jo recruiters various team managers ke saath set up karte hain.

  • How do you train/ramp up engineers who are new to the team?
  • What does success look like for your team/project?
  • What are the strengths and weaknesses of the current team? What is being done to improve upon the weaknesses?
  • Can you tell me about a time you resolved an interpersonal conflict?
  • How did you become a manager?
  • How do your engineers know what to work on each day?
  • What is your team's biggest challenge right now?
  • How do you measure individual performance?
  • How often are 1:1s conducted?
  • What is the current team composition like?
  • What opportunities are available to switch roles? How does this work?
  • Two senior team members disagree over a technical issue. How do you handle it?
  • Have you managed a poor performer at some point in your career before? What did you do and how did it work?
  • Where do you spend more of your time, high performers or low performers?
  • Sometimes there's a trade-off between what's best for one of your team members and what's best for the team. Give an example of how you handled this and why.
  • Give an example of a time you faced a difficult mentoring/coaching challenge. What did you do and why?
  • What is your management philosophy?
  • What is the role of data and metrics in managing a team like ours?
  • What role does the manager play in making technical decisions?
  • What is an example of a change you have made in the team that improved the team?
  • What would be the most important problem you would want me to solve if I joined your team?
  • What opportunities for growth will your team provide?
  • What would I work on if I joined this team and who would I work most closely with?

Company direction ke baare me jaanne ke liye

  • How does the company decide on what to work on next?
  • What assurance do you have that this company will be successful?
  • Which companies are your main competitors and what differentiates your company?
  • What are your highest priorities right now? For example, new features, new products, solidifying existing code, reducing operations overhead?
Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/final-questions.md
← PehlePerfect Self Introduction Kaise BanayeinAgla →Negotiation — Hamesha Negotiate Karo
51Negotiation, Compensation & Career

Negotiation — Hamesha Negotiate Karo

Offer (ya behtar — offers) mil gaya ho to congratulations. Tumhe lag sakta hai ki sabse mushkil part khatm ho gaya — haan, lekin poori tarah nahi. Zyada tar logon ke liye nayi job dhoondhne ka reason salary badhana hota hai, aur salary negotiation us goal ko achieve karne ka aakhri stretch hai.

Ye baat jo recruiters nahi batana chahte: zyada tar cases me offer par negotiate karne ki gunjaish hoti hai aur recruiters expect karte hain ki candidates negotiate karenge. Jo initial offer diya jaata hai, wo kabhi company ka best package nahi hota. Multiple top tech companies se offers milne par har company se behtar offer negotiate karna possible tha — kuch aspects negotiate karna doosron se aasaan hota hai. Multiple offers haath me hon to sabse achha bargaining chip hota hai.

Negotiation services

Agar tumne past offers negotiate nahi kiye hon, ya negotiation game me naye ho, to chinta mat karo — multiple negotiation services help kar sakti hain. Aam taur par ye apni cost se zyada worth hoti hain.

Rora

Rora me experienced professionals ki team tumhe poori salary negotiation process me guide karti hai. Ye risk-free hai kyunki tumhe kuch pay nahi karna hota jab tak increased offer na mile. Rora ye kar sakta hai: competing offers ke bina bhi increases negotiate karne me help; bahut si companies me compensation ranges ki knowledge se tailored advice; recruiters se kya aur kaise baat karni hai, iske liye customized scripts (alag-alag scenarios ke liye); practice ke liye mock negotiation services; recruiter call ke dauraan chat se live guidance; doosri companies ke recruiters se introduce karwana.

Levels.fyi

Levels.fyi salary database ke liye famous hai, lekin complementary services bhi offer karta hai — jaise salary negotiation, jahan tumhe experienced recruiters se connect kiya jaata hai. Rora se farq ye hai ki Levels.fyi flat fee charge karta hai, jabki Rora negotiated difference ka percentage leta hai.

Negotiation courses

Agar negotiation services ke liye pay nahi karna chahte aur courses pasand hain, to Grokking Comp Negotiation in Tech course hai (Educative) — text-based course jisme negotiation ke har aspect ki information hai.

Yaad rakho: Paise table par chhodkar mat jao — negotiation help lena (risk-free service ya course) aksar apni cost se kai guna zyada return deta hai.
Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/negotiation.md
← PehleInterview Ke Ant Me Poochhne Wale Best QuestionsAgla →Negotiation Ke 10 Rules
52Negotiation, Compensation & Career

Negotiation Ke 10 Rules

Neeche ke key points ek popular negotiation guide ("Ten Rules for Negotiating a Job Offer", Part 1 aur Part 2) se extract kiye gaye hain. Guide ka naam ya author is SPA me nahi diya gaya hai — poora guide Source link se padh sakte ho.

1. Sab kuch likh lo

Recruiters ke saath phone call par EVERYTHING note kar lo — baad me helpful ho sakta hai. Chahe cheezein seedha monetary na hon, agar job se related hain to likh lo. Agar wo kahein "hum front-end ko Angular par port karne par kaam kar rahe hain", to likh lo. Agar wo kahein 20 employees hain, to likh lo. Jitni zyada information, utna behtar — bahut kuch bhool jaoge, aur final decision lene me ye important hoga.

2. Hamesha door khula rakho

Apni negotiating power kabhi mat chhodo jab tak informed, deliberate final decision lene ke liye poori tarah taiyaar na ho. Tumhara kaam hai decision points se guzarte hue power banaye rakhna. Aksar tumhara interlocutor tumhe decision lene ke liye trick karega ya tumhe aisi decision se baandhne ki koshish karega jo tumne commit nahi ki. Tumhe verbally in antics se nikalte rehna hai jab tak actually final decision lene ke liye taiyaar na ho.

3. Information hi power hai

Negotiation me apni power protect karne ke liye information ko jitna ho sake protect karo. Iska corollary ye hai ki companies ko ye nahi batana chahiye ki tum currently kya kama rahe ho. Offer milne par zyada paise ya equity ya kuch bhi maango mat — offer ki specific details par comment mat karo, sirf clarify karo. Companies alag-alag stages par current compensation poochhengi — interview se pehle, ya offer decide karne ke baad. Iska dhyaan rakho aur information protect karo.

Example script: "Haan, [COMPANY_NAME] great lagti hai! Mujhe laga tha ye good fit hai, aur mujhe khushi hai ki aap bhi agree karte hain. Abhi main kuch aur companies se baat kar raha hoon, isliye offer ki specific details par tab tak baat nahi kar sakta jab tak process khatm na ho jaaye aur decision ke kareeb na aa jaaun. Lekin mujhe yakeen hai ki hum aisa package dhoondh lenge jisse hum dono khush hon, kyunki main team ka part banna chahta hoon."

4. Hamesha positive raho

Offer bura bhi ho to positive aur company ke liye excited rehna extremely important hai — tumhari excitement negotiation me sabse valuable assets me se ek hai. Jo kuch bhi ho raha ho, company ko ye impression do: (1) tumhe company abhi bhi pasand hai, aur (2) tum wahan kaam karne ke liye abhi bhi excited ho, chahe numbers/paise/timing kaam na kar rahe hon. Sabse convincing tareeka hai baar-baar batana ki tumhe mission, team ya problem pasand hai aur tum chahte ho ki cheezein work out hon.

5. Decision maker mat bano

Chahe tumhe friends/family/partner ki raay ki parwah ho ya na ho, unka mention karne se recruiter ko sirf tumhe jeetna nahi padta — "true decision-maker" unki reach se bahar hai. Recruiter ko bully ya intimidate karne ka koi point nahi rehta; phone par baat karne wala insaan sirf apna kaam kar raha hai, decision uska nahi hai. Isse tension defuse hoti hai aur tumhe zyada control milta hai.

Example: "Main in details ko dekhunga aur apne [FAMILY/CLOSE_FRIENDS/SIGNIFICANT_OTHER] se discuss karunga. Koi questions hon to reach out karunga. Good news share karne ke liye bahut thanks, aur main touch me rahunga!" Kisi ko pressure karna bahut mushkil hai agar wo final decision-maker hi na ho — iska fayda uthao.

6. Alternatives rakho

Agar tum pehle se doosri companies ke pipeline me ho (jo tumhe hona chahiye agar sahi tareeke se kar rahe ho), to proactively reach out karo aur batao ki offer mil gaya hai. Urgency ka sense banao. Expiration date pata ho ya na ho, saare offers kabhi na kabhi expire hote hain — iska fayda uthao.

Example letter: "Hello [PERSON], main apne process par update dena chahta tha. Mujhe abhi [COMPANY] se offer mila hai jo kaafi strong hai. Uske saath hi, main [YOUR AMAZING COMPANY] ko lekar really excited hoon aur dekhna chahta hoon ki kya hum ise work kar sakte hain. Meri timeline ab compress ho gayi hai, isliye kya process expedite karne ke liye kuch kar sakte ho?"

Kya specifically mention karna chahiye ki kis company se offer mila hai? Depend karta hai. Agar well-known company ya competitor hai to definitely mention karo. Agar no-name ya unsexy company hai to bas kaho offer mila hai. Expire hone wala ho to wo bhi mention karo. Jo bhi ho, ye letter har company ko bhejo jisse baat kar rahe ho — kitni bhi hopeless lage, tum chahte ho ki market me tumhe consider karne wale sab ko ye signal mile.

Companies ko parwah hai ki tumhe doosre offers mile hain — kyunki har company jaanti hai ki uska process noisy hai, aur doosri companies ke processes bhi noisy hain. Lekin candidate ke paas multiple offers hona matlab uske favor me multiple weak signals hain — combined, ye kisi ek interview se bahut strong signal ban jaate hain. Jaise student ka strong SAT score, GPA aur scholarships jeetna — ho sakta hai wo dunce ho, lekin aisa hona bahut mushkil hai.

Tumhara goal hona chahiye ki ek hi time par zyada se zyada offers overlap karein — isse negotiation ka window maximize hoga. Strong BATNA (Best Alternative To a Negotiated Agreement) rakho aur communicate karo. Example: "Mujhe [OTHER CORP] se ek aur offer mila hai jo salary par bahut compelling hai, lekin mujhe [YOUR COMPANY] ka mission bahut pasand hai aur lagta hai overall better fit hoga." Ya: "Main grad school wapas jaakar Postmodern Haberdashery me Master's karne par bhi consider kar raha hoon. Main [YOUR COMPANY] ko lekar excited hoon aur join karna chahta hoon, lekin package ko sense banana hoga agar mujhe ironic hatmaking ki zindagi chhodni hai."

7. Har cheez ke liye reasons batao

Ye tumhare liye aur negotiating partner ke liye brain-hack hai. Sirf reason batane se (koi bhi reason) tumhari request human aur important lagti hai. Ye tum greedy nahi ho, apne goals fulfill karne ki koshish kar rahe ho. Reason jitna unobjectionable aur sympathetic ho, utna behtar — medical expenses, student loans pay karna, ya family ki dekhbhal ho to recruiters ki aankhon me aansu aa jaayenge. Har cheez ke liye reason batao, aur paoge ki recruiters tumhare advocate banne ke liye zyada willing hain.

8. Sirf paise se motivate mat ho

Paise se bhi motivate hona chahiye, lekin wo optimize karne wale kai dimensions me se ek hona chahiye. Kitni training milegi, pehla project kya hoga, kis team me jaoge, mentor kaun hoga — ye sab cheezein hain jo negotiate kar sakte ho aur karni chahiye. Achhe se negotiate karne ke liye doosri side ki preferences samajhni hongi — deal ko dono ke liye behtar banana hai.

9. Samjho wo kya value karte hain

Yaad rakho — salary raises to kaam karte hue milte rahenge, lekin signing bonus paane ka ek hi point hota hai. Company ko dene me sabse aasaan cheez stock hoti hai (agar company stock offer karti hai). Companies stock dena pasand karti hain kyunki ye tumhe company me invest karta hai aur interests align karta hai. Ye risk ka kuch hissa company se tum par shift kar deta hai aur kam cash burn karta hai.

10. Winnable raho

Ye sirf company ko ye impression dene se zyada hai ki tumhe wo pasand hai (jo tumhe continually karna chahiye). Tumhe har company ko clear path dena hoga ki wo tumhe kaise jeet sakti hai. Bullshit mat karo ya stupid games mat khelo. Apni preferences aur timeline ko lekar clear aur unequivocal raho. Unka time waste mat karo ya apne purposes ke liye games mat khelo. Company tumhari dream company na bhi ho, to bhi tumhe kam se kam koi package imagine karna chahiye jo tum sign karne ko taiyaar ho. Agar nahi, to politely decline kar do.

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/negotiation-rules.md
← PehleNegotiation — Hamesha Negotiate KaroAgla →Compensation Samjho — Base, Bonus, Equity, Signing Bonus
53Negotiation, Compensation & Career

Compensation Samjho — Base, Bonus, Equity, Signing Bonus

Compensation job offers ke beech decide karne ke sabse bade factors me se ek hai. Is section me tech industry me compensation ke common components ka breakdown hai. Zyada tar companies me compensation base salary, performance bonus aur equity/stocks se milkar banta hai. Compensation data ke liye Levels.fyi check karo.

Base salary

Base salary fixed amount hai jo kaam par aane ke liye milta hai — company ya industry kaisa perform kar rahi hai, isse unaffected rehta hai. Ye compensation ka ek hi non-variable component hai. Bay Area me fresh graduates ko aam taur par USD 100,000 se upar base salary expect karni chahiye (taxes se pehle). Facebook/Google me fresh graduates ki salary USD 100,000–150,000 range me hoti hai. Startups fresh graduates ko thoda zyada offer karte hain (USD 120,000–130,000) taaki equity grant ki liquidity ki kami compensate ho sake (abhi real cash nahi hai).

Base salary senior hote jaane par linearly nahi badhti — eventually taper off ho jaati hai. Jaise employees company me senior hote jaate hain, unki compensation ka zyada proportion company-dependent factors (bonus aur equity) se aata hai. Senior employees se expect kiya jaata hai ki wo aas-paas ke logon ko influence karein aur company ko aage badhayein. Senior employee ki performance company ke overall performance par based hoti hai; individual factor utna nahi hota.

Exceptions bhi hain: Netflix industry me top pay karta hai (kabhi-kabhi Facebook/Google se bhi zyada) aur employees ko poori compensation base salary ke roop me lene ka option deta hai — equity component ko base me convert karke. Risk-adverse logon ke liye ye great choice hai.

Bonus

Bonuses aam taur par semi-annual basis par pay kiye jaate hain aur kuch factors par depend karte hain — seniority level, us time period me individual performance, aur us time period me company performance.

  • Level of seniority — ye aam taur par base salary ka multiplier hota hai, aur rank upar jaane par multiplier badhta hai.
  • Individual performance — us time period me tumne kaisa perform kiya, iska multiplier. Expectations meet karna 100% multiplier deta hai, exceed karna >100% deta hai. Facebook aur Apple jaise companies top performers ko handsomely reward karti hain — multiplier extremely high-performing employees ke liye 300% tak ja sakta hai.
  • Company performance — company kaisa kar rahi hai. Ye multiplier saare employees ke liye same hota hai.

Example 1 — Fresh graduate

Ek Software Engineer college se fresh nikla hai. Base salary $100,000 hai, fresh grad hai (seniority multiplier: 10%), us half me expectations crush ki (individual performance multiplier: 200%) aur company ne kaafi achha kiya (company performance multiplier: 120%). Us half ka bonus: 100,000 × 50% (aadha saal) × 10% (seniority) × 200% (individual performance) × 120% (company performance) = $12,000.

Example 2 — Engineering Manager

Ek Engineering Manager ke paas 10 saal ka professional experience hai. Base salary $220,000 hai, experienced engineering manager hai (seniority multiplier: 20%), us half me expectations exceed ki (individual performance multiplier: 150%) aur company ne awesome kiya (company performance multiplier: 130%). Us half ka bonus: 220,000 × 50% × 20% × 150% × 130% = $42,900.

Isliye bonus ki amount highly variable ho sakti hai, aur senior employees ko total compensation ka zyada proportion bonuses se milta hai.

Equity/stocks

Equity hi tech job ko non-tech job se alag karti hai. Equity matlab company ka hissa — ownership signify karta hai aur employees ko company ke best interests me kaam karne ke liye motivate karta hai. Ye compensation ka significant portion ho sakti hai, kabhi-kabhi base salary se bhi zyada — khaas taur par senior employees ke liye.

Equity aam taur par time ke saath vest hoti hai (typically 4 saal) aur har month/quarter/year equally vest kar sakti hai. Vesting cliff matlab minimum period jiske baad vesting shuru hoti hai. Example: 4,800 shares 4 saal ke schedule par, 1 saal cliff aur monthly vesting ke saath — pehle saal ke ant me 1,200 shares milenge, phir agle 3 saal har mahine 100 shares milenge.

Jab tak company public (IPO) nahi hoti ya acquire nahi hoti, equity aam taur par kuch worth nahi hoti. Lekin aise instances hain jahan stocks internally beche ja sakte hain, company public na hone par bhi. Kya le rahe ho, iska dhyaan rakho.

Saari equity equally treat nahi hoti. Company aur uske stage ke hisaab se tumhe stock options ya stock grants me se koi ek mil sakta hai.

Stock options

Stock options aam taur par mid-stage companies deti hain. Stock options stocks se alag hote hain — stocks immediate ownership represent karte hain, jabki stock options stocks ko ek given strike price par purchase karne ka option/right hote hain — free nahi hote. Lekin har stock ki cost aam taur par bahut kam hoti hai aur strike price par fixed hoti hai, jo grant ke waqt stock ki fair market value ke barabar hoti hai. Tumhe guarantee hoti hai ki future increases ke bawajood tum usi price par stock purchase kar sakte ho. Company chhodte waqt exercise window hoti hai (options exercise karne ki deadline) — isliye departure plan karte waqt unhe purchase karne ke liye kaafi liquid cash hona important hai.

Stock grants (RSUs)

Stock grant ko aam taur par Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) kaha jaata hai — matlab tumhe stock immediately mil jaata hai. Company public ho to defined trading windows me bech sakte ho.

Signing bonus

Ye one-time lump sum hota hai jo join karte waqt pay kiya jaata hai. Amount aam taur par USD 10,000–20,000 range me hoti hai, lekin USD 50,000 (Google) aur USD 100,000 (Facebook) tak bhi ja sakti hai. Signing bonuses ke saath conditions ho sakti hain — jaise ek saal ke mark se pehle chhodne par pro-rated amount wapas karni padti hai. Offer sign karne se pehle in conditions ko jaan lo.

Misc bonuses/perks

Ye perks exactly cash nahi hote, lekin paise bachane me madad karte hain — jo almost compensated zyada hone ke barabar hai. Recruiters se inke baare me poochho:

  • Free meals — Bay Area me khana cheap nahi hai; weekdays par kuch meals milne se saal me kuch hazaar dollars aur travel ka time bachta hai.
  • Relocation bonus — abroad se move kar rahe ho to helpful; relocation costs partially offset ho jaate hain.
  • Health aur dental insurance/plans — companies aksar insurance companies se partner karke health aur dental plans deti hain; saal me kuch hazaar dollars worth ho sakte hain, khaas taur par jahan healthcare mehenga hai.
  • Shuttle service — Bay Area me public transportation utna achha nahi hai, zyada tar log drive karte hain. Shuttle se gas/transport ka paisa bachta hai aur commute ke dauraan dimaag free rehta hai.

← PehleNegotiation Ke 10 RulesAgla →Companies Ke Beech Kaise Chuno
54Negotiation, Compensation & Career

Companies Ke Beech Kaise Chuno

Interviews pass karke multiple offers mil gaye hon to congratulations — lekin ab ek aur problem hai (achhi wali!): kis company ko join karo? Neeche factors hain jo decide karte waqt consider karne chahiye. Har individual alag hai aur kuch factors kuch logon ko zyada/kam matter karte hain — sirf tum hi decide kar sakte ho ki tumhare liye best kya hai. Decide karne se pehle companies par due diligence karo.

Compensation

Sabse pehle compensation. Zyada tar tech roles me compensation similar components me milta hai — Base salary, Bonuses, Stocks, aur Sign On. Detail Understanding Compensation section me hai. Kuch companies offer me flexible hoti hain — higher base salary ya higher stocks me se chunne deti hain. Base salary samajhne me sabse straightforward hai — company kaisa bhi perform kare, wahi amount milti hai. Bonuses bhi aam taur par base salary ka percentage hote hain, isliye high base salary risk-adverse logon ke liye great hai.

Saare stock grants equal nahi hote. Kuch companies me linear vesting cycles hote hain (har saal same amount vest hoti hai), kuch (jaise Amazon aur Snap) me backloaded schemes hote hain (pehle saalon me kam vest hota hai, baad me zyada), aur cliffs par bhi dhyaan do. Stripe aur Lyft ne recently apna stock structure change karke first year me equity payouts speed up karne ka announcement kiya — initially achha lagta hai, lekin asal me kuch nuances hain. Kisi bhi company me hamesha negotiate karo — khaas taur par multiple offers hon to. Multiple offers haath me hona best bargaining chip hai — leverage karo.

Products

Company kis cheez par kaam karti hai, aur kya wo domain tumhe interested karta hai? Zyada tar big tech companies me har tarah ke products par teams kaam karti hain — ads networks, chat, enterprise offerings, video watching, payments, hardware products, industry-leading AI tools, internal tools, etc. Har big tech company kisi cheez ke liye uniquely known hai — wo unke DNA me hai:

  • Meta/Facebook — Social networks (Facebook, Instagram), chat (WhatsApp, Messenger), Metaverse (Oculus).
  • Google — Search, browsers (Google Chrome), Google Maps, cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud Platform), enterprise collaboration (Google Suite).
  • Amazon — Cloud infrastructure (Amazon Web Services), e-commerce.
  • Microsoft — Operating systems, Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Apple — Hardware, operating systems, services (iCloud, Apple Music).

Personally, jin products ko external user ke roop me bhi use karta hoon, un par kaam karne me zyada motivated aur productive mehsoos hota hai — user perspective se product ki behtar samajh hoti hai, jo behtar engineering aur product decisions ki taraf le ja sakti hai.

Prospective teams

Company alag-alag products par kaam kar sakti hai, lekin kuch products sirf kuch offices me bante hain. Example: Google Singapore primarily Payments par kaam karta hai — agar search me interested ho to Google Singapore great fit nahi hoga, lekin future me Google employee rehte hue relocate karna possible hai. Pata karo ki tumhari intended location par kaunse products/teams kaam karte hain, taaki andaza ho ki join karne par working life kaisi hogi.

Company prospects

Agar stocks milte hain to company ke prospects tumhari compensation ko affect karenge. Kya company aane wale saalon me successful hone ke liye poised hai, ya kuch factors progress hinder kar rahe hain?

Career growth

Company apne employees ko kitni fast promote karti hai aur grow karne ke opportunities deti hai? Chhoti companies me multiple hats pehnne padte hain aur 0 se 1 tak bahut saare products banane ko milte hain — product building skills grow karne wale logon ke liye great hai. Lekin technical growth limited ho sakti hai kyunki company product work par focus karti hai, infrastructure building par kam — infrastructure aam taur par scale par hi chahiye hota hai. 10 logon ki chhoti startup me Principal Engineer ki zaroorat hi nahi hoti, jahan sab products banane me lage hote hain. Career growth company ke size aur product offerings ke scope se limited ho sakti hai.

Kuch companies doosron se fast promote karti hain. Ek kehna hai: Google jao rest aur vest karne, Meta jao career accelerate karne. Experience se aur peers ko dekhkar ye kaafi accurate laga hai. Meta me engineers ko E3 se E4 2 saal me aur E4 se E5 3 saal me karna hota hai. Google ka promotion cycle slow hai — average engineer ko L3 se L4 2 saal se zyada, L4 se L5 3 saal se zyada aur L5 se L6 4 saal se zyada lagte hain. Google me terminal level L4 hai, isliye promote karne ka pressure nahi hai. Google ke koi peer L6 nahi hai, lekin kuch Meta me E6 ban chuke hain aur ye kaafi achievable hai. Google excellent engineers banna seekhne ke liye great jagah hai — har cheez well-engineered honi chahiye, design docs aur high test coverage ke saath. Meta career-driven logon ke liye great jagah hai jo career path accelerate karne ke liye zyada mehnat karne me comfortable hain.

Company culture

Company culture matlab company leadership aur employees ki beliefs aur behaviors. Tech giants apni unique cultures ke liye famous hain:

  • Google — candidates "Googleyness" factor ke liye evaluate kiye jaate hain — traits jo Google employees me hone chahiye: "Doing the right thing", "Striving for excellence", "Comfort with ambiguity". Google engineering quality aur data-driven decision making par high emphasis ke liye jaana jaata hai.
  • Meta/Facebook — shuru ke dinon me internal motto tha "Move fast and break things" — products fast ship karne par focus. 2014 me ise "Move fast with stable infrastructure" kar diya gaya, kyunki platform mature ho gaya tha aur stability par focus hona chahiye tha.
  • Netflix — Netflix culture deck publicly available hai; core philosophy hai people over process. Wo khud ko professional sports teams ki tarah sochte hain — star players ko rakhna aur adequate performers ko jaane dena, family ki tarah operate karne ke bajay (bad behavior tolerate karna aur unconditional love dikhana).

Engineering culture — 12-point test

Tech culture deserve karta hai special mention. Ek popular engineering-culture test me 12 points hain jinse evaluate kiya ja sakta hai ki tech company ki software engineering culture healthy hai ya nahi:

  1. Equity or profit sharing — employees ko equity milti hai?
  2. Roadmap/backlog that engineers contribute to — engineers team ki roadmap me contribute karte hain?
  3. Engineers directly working with other ICs — engineers doosre roles (Designers, PMs, Data Scientists, etc.) ke saath directly kaam karte hain?
  4. Code reviews and testing — engineers peer code reviews karte hain aur tests aksar likhte hain?
  5. CI and engineers pushing to prod — continuous integration hai ya engineers production me deploy kar sakte hain?
  6. Internal open source — engineers company bhar ki code bases access aur contribute kar sakte hain?
  7. Healthy oncall as a priority — oncall load manageable hai?
  8. Technical managers — engineering managers ke paas technical background aur skills hain?
  9. Career ladder (10+ engineers hone par) — career ladders aur har level ki expectations well-defined hain?
  10. Parallel IC & manager tracks (30+ engineers hone par) — IC ke roop me career ladder par upar badha ja sakta hai?
  11. Feedback culture — ek-doosre/company ko feedback dena practice me hai?
  12. Investing in professional growth — professional growth ke liye stipend, mentorship program hai?

Ye koi surprise nahi hai ki FAANG companies saare 12 points hit karti hain. Detail ke liye Pragmatic Engineer test wala blog post padho.

Work-life balance

Common practice hai hafte me 40 ghante aur din me 8 ghante kaam karna, lekin kuch jagahen zyada stressful hone ke liye infamous hain aur employees se zyada time maangti hain. Kuch Chinese companies 6 din hafte me kaam karwane ke liye famous hain. Zyada tar tech employees ko overtime ka pay nahi milta, isliye kabhi-kabhi salary calculate karne ka zyada accurate tareeka dollars per hour hota hai, raw annual total compensation ke bajay. Google slow move karne aur rest-and-vest karne ki jagah ke liye famous hai, jabki Amazon ko employee survey me work-life balance ke liye C- score mila tha.

Transfers and mobility

Kya company ke globe bhar me offices hain jahan employees relocate kar sakte hain? Chhoti companies ke liye ye out of question hai jahan sirf ek headquarters hai, lekin kuch companies remote allow karti hain aur kuch entirely remote hain. Meta, Google, Apple aur Stripe global presence aur regional headquarters wali companies hain. Meta aur Google me mobility extremely high hai — US bhar me, London, Tel Aviv aur haal me Singapore me bade engineering offices hain. Ek manager ne 4 offices me kaam kiya tha. Personally, Meta/Facebook Menlo Park se Meta/Facebook Singapore relocate kiya tha COVID se pehle, aur Meta/Google ke kai doston ne similar moves kiye hain, kuch Singapore se US bhi gaye.

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/choosing-between-companies.md

55Negotiation, Compensation & Career

Engineering Levels — Junior se Distinguished Tak

Engineers ke liye various career levels samajhna crucial hai — ye determine karne me madad karta hai ki tumhe kitni compensation milni chahiye aur har level par tumse kya expect kiya jaata hai. Zyada tar companies me career levels kuch is tarah hote hain: Junior → Software Engineer → Senior → Staff → Senior Staff → Principal → Distinguished.

Career levels

Neeche diye gaye levels aam taur par bahut si technology companies me hote hain; specific responsibilities, years of experience aur doosre factors company se company vary kar sakte hain.

Junior Software Engineer

Description: entry-level role — seekhne aur practical experience gain karne par focus. Influence: Individual. Scope of work: Task-level. Responsibilities: code likhna, debugging, testing, team members ke saath collaborate karna. Aam taur par well-defined tasks aur projects par zyada experienced engineers ki guidance me kaam karna. Experience: typically 0–2 saal, recent graduates ya career ke early stages wale log.

Software Engineer

Description: mid-level role — broader responsibilities aur zyada independence. Influence: Individual / Team. Scope of work: Features / small projects. Responsibilities: software solutions design, implement aur maintain karna; cross-functional teams ke saath collaborate karna; code reviews me participate karna; development process me contribute karna. Experience: typically 2–5 saal (company aur individual progression par depend).

Senior Software Engineer

Description: experienced individual contributor — deeper technical understanding. Influence: Team. Scope of work: Large features / multiple small projects. Responsibilities: complex technical projects lead karna; junior engineers mentor karna; architectural decisions lena; overall software design aur development process me contribute karna. Experience: typically 5+ saal, significant software projects successfully deliver karne ka track record.

Staff Software Engineer

Description: highly skilled individual contributor — specific domains ya technologies me expertise. Influence: Large team / Area (multiple/neighboring teams). Scope of work: multiple halves me chalne wale bade projects. Responsibilities: critical technical components ka ownership lena; technical leadership dena; projects ki architectural direction guide karna; doosri teams ke liye technical advisor bhi ban sakte hain. Experience: typically 10+ saal, strong technical background.

Senior Staff Software Engineer

Description: Staff Software Engineer role ka zyada advanced version. Influence: Organization / Company. Scope of work: multiple halves/years me chalne wale bade projects jo organization ke liye crucial hain. Responsibilities: major technical initiatives lead karna; technical strategy set karna; multiple teams ko mentorship aur guidance dena; company ki technical direction par significant impact ho sakta hai. Experience: typically 15+ saal, complex projects deliver karne ka proven track record.

Principal Software Engineer

Description: recognized technical leader — ek ya zyada areas me deep expertise. Influence: Company / Industry. Scope of work: multiple halves/years me chalne wale bade projects jo poori company ko affect karte hain. Responsibilities: company ya specific projects ke liye technical vision define aur drive karna; architectural decisions lead karna; aksar technical authority ki tarah kaam karna. Experience: zyada tar engineers is level tak nahi pahunchte; technical innovation aur leadership ka strong record chahiye.

Distinguished Engineer aur uske aage

Description: bahut si organizations me highest individual contributor role — sabse respected technical experts me se ek, technical career ka pinnacle. Influence: Industry. Scope of work: multiple halves/years me chalne wale huge projects jo poori company ya industry ko affect karte hain. Responsibilities: highest-level technical strategy set karna; industry standards ko influence karna; company leadership aur industry ko technical advisor ki tarah serve karna; industry forums aur standards bodies me company ko represent karna. Experience: zyada tar engineers is level tak nahi pahunchte; significant technical excellence, innovation, leadership aur industry recognition ka lamba history chahiye — organization ke andar hi nahi, broader industry me bhi expert ke roop me recognize kiye jaate hain.

Ye roles companies ke beech widely vary kar sakte hain — kuch organizations me additional levels ya alag titles bhi ho sakte hain. Soft skills, leadership abilities aur company culture/goals me contributions bhi career progression me technical expertise ke aage significant role play karte hain.

Source:https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/blob/main/apps/website/contents/engineering-levels.md

Interactive Labs

8 labs — mushkil concepts ko haath se try karo. Har lab ka output neeche turant dikhta hai.

LABLab 01 · STAR Story Builder

STAR Story Builder

Big-O Quiz — Data Structures

LABLab 03 · Sliding Window Lab — Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters

Sliding Window Lab — Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters

LABLab 04 · Binary Search Visualizer

Binary Search Visualizer

LABLab 05 · Bonus Calculator — Handbook Formula

Bonus Calculator — Handbook Formula

LABLab 06 · Resume ATS Checker

Resume ATS Checker
