58Interview FAQs

Interview FAQs

Interview taiyaari me sabse zyada poochhe jaane wale 36 sawaal — har sawaal par click karo, jawab khulega.

Q01Coding interview ki taiyaari me kitna time lagta hai?

Handbook ke mutaabik bare minimum ke liye lagbhag 30 ghante aur achhi taiyaari ke liye lagbhag 100 ghante lagte hain. Recommended plan 3 mahine ka hai — hafte me 11 ghante, matlab din me 2–3 ghante. Kam time ho to Grind 75 tool se apne time ke hisaab se custom plan banao. Pehle core data structures aur algorithms revise karo, phir questions ki practice shuru karo.

Q02Coding interview ke liye kaunsi programming language best hai?

Python, C++, Java aur JavaScript recommended hain. Python sabse popular choice hai kyunki succinct hai aur standard library me bahut functions aur data structures hain. Lekin sabse important tumhari familiarity hai — jo language sabse comfortable ho, wahi use karo. Nayi language sirf interview ke liye seekhna achha idea nahi hai. Google me sirf Java, C++, JavaScript ya Python allowed hain.

Q03LeetCode par hazaaron questions hain — kaunse karun?

Sab karne ki jaroorat nahi hai. Handbook ka 5-week schedule 50 questions ka hai (Blind 75 se distill kiya gaya) — Week 1 sequences, Week 2 data structures, Week 3 non-linear data structures, Week 4 aur data structures, Week 5 dynamic programming. Bahut se doosre LeetCode questions inhi ki techniques ka mash-up hote hain. 3-month plan me Week 1–4 topics aur Week 5–12 me 75 questions (Grind 75) hain.

Q04Coding interview me evaluate kaise kiya jaata hai?

Top companies 4 dimensions par evaluate karti hain: Communication (clarifying questions, approach samjhana), Problem Solving (systematic approach, tradeoffs, optimization), Technical Competency (working code, clean implementation) aur Testing (normal aur corner cases, khud bugs correct karna). Scoring bands hain: Strong hire, Hire, No hire, Strong no hire. Phone screen me 'Leaning hire' ya upar na mile to aage nahi badhte.

Q05Interview me question milte hi kya karna chahiye?

Turant code mat likhne lago. Pehle question ko paraphrase karke interviewer ko sunao, phir kam se kam 2–3 clarifying questions poochho — assumptions, input range, input format (negative? empty? duplicates?), aur kya input modify kar sakte ho. Ek simplified example se samajh check karo. Phir approach discuss karo, tradeoffs batao, complexity explain karo, aur interviewer ki green light ke baad hi code likhna shuru karo.

Q06System design interview me kya poochha jaata hai?

Mid/senior candidates se real-world systems design karne ko kaha jaata hai — jaise URL shortener, Twitter, YouTube, chat service, file sharing, Uber, photo sharing, e-commerce, jobs portal ya web crawler. 4 types hote hain: back end/distributed system design (sabse common), API system design, object-oriented design aur front end system design. Approach: requirements clarify karo, capacity estimate karo, API design karo, data model banao, high-level design dikhao, deep dive karo aur bottlenecks discuss karo.

Q07System design me fan-out on write aur fan-out on read kya hai?

Ye Twitter jaisi timeline design ka core tradeoff hai. Fan-out on write: tweet karte hi saare followers ki timeline me push kar do — read fast hoti hai, write heavy hota hai. Fan-out on read: timeline kholte waqt follow kiye gaye logon ke tweets pull karo — write light, read slow. Hybrid approach best hai: normal users ke liye fan-out on write, celebrities (lakhon followers) ke liye fan-out on read.

Q08Behavioral interview me STAR format kya hai?

STAR ka matlab hai Situation, Task, Action, Results. Situation: recent challenge aur context batao. Task: kya achieve karna tha. Action: tumne kya kiya, kyun kiya, alternatives kya the. Results: outcome kya tha aur kya seekha. Seniority dikhane ke liye ek aur R add karo — Reflection: experience se kya seekha. 3–5 key stories taiyaar rakho (high impact, high complexity, high involvement) aur unhe alag-alag questions par reuse karo.

Q09Behavioral interview me sabse common questions kaunse hain?

Top 30 me ye hain: Why do you want to work for X company? Why leave your current company? Tell me about a time you had a conflict with a co-worker. Most challenging project kya tha? Most difficult bug kya fix kiya? How do you tackle challenges? What frustrates you? Tell me about a time you met a tight deadline. What would colleagues use to describe you? What would you achieve in the first six months? Poori 30-question list aur company-specific lists (Airbnb, Amazon, Palantir, Slack aur aur) is SPA ke Behavioral section me hain.

Q10Senior candidates ke behavioral interviews me kya alag hota hai?

Senior roles (Staff+ aur upar) me behavioral interviews hi deciding factor ho sakte hain. Tumhe organizational impact, complexity navigation aur leadership ke liye evaluate kiya jaata hai. Stories me 4 dimensions dikhane hote hain: technical leadership, people leadership, process/operational leadership aur strategic/business leadership. 'Table of Contents' approach use karo, impact ko front-load karo, interruptions ke liye taiyaar raho aur defensively socho — koi bhi framing uncharitable interpretation na de.

Q11FAANG-ready resume kaise likhun?

4 steps hain: (1) ATS-friendly template setup karo — sirf Word ya Google Docs se banao, PDF me submit karo, standard fonts (Arial/Calibri/Garamond, min 10pt), standard headings aur order. (2) Content bharo — professional summary 50 words se kam, headline 10 words se kam, work experience me accomplishments 'summary: action that resulted in quantifiable outcome' format me. (3) Keywords optimize karo — job description ke keywords Skills aur Work Experience me daalo, lekin keyword stuffing mat karo. (4) Free tools se test karo — Resume Worded, AI Resume Judge, aur plain text file test.

Q12Resume me ATS kya hota hai aur usse kaise pass karun?

ATS (Applicant Tracking System) hazaaron resumes ko human eyes tak pahunchne se pehle parse aur screen karta hai — kuch ATS certain rules se automatically reject bhi kar dete hain. Pass karne ke liye: Word/Google Docs se banao (Photoshop ya online builders nahi), header/footer use mat karo (margins kam karo), standard fonts aur headings use karo, headers me symbols mat lagao, aur job description ke keywords include karo. Plain text test karo — resume copy karke plain text me paste karo, agar kuch missing ya galat dikhe to fix karo.

Q13Self introduction ('Tell me about yourself') kaise dun?

Ise elevator pitch ki tarah banao — short, direct aur attention-grabbing. Structure: (1) basic background — kaun ho, kahan kaam karte ho, kya karte ho; (2) KISS — favorite projects ke highlights numbers ke saath, depth me mat jao; (3) why do they want you — experience company se relevant kaise hai. History lesson mat sunao. Practice karo taaki natural lage, memorized na lage. Role aur company ke hisaab se tailor karo.

Q14Interview ke ant me kya questions poochhne chahiye?

Hamesha questions poochho — bina questions ke interview khatm karna kam interest dikhata hai. Best questions: engineering challenges kya hain? Sabse badi technical blunder kya thi aur uske baad kya badla? Early costly technical decision kaunsi hai jise company abhi bhi jhel rahi hai? Role ke liye hire karte waqt kaunsi qualities dekhte ho? Team me join karke sabse important problem kaunsi solve karni hogi? Working here ka sabse frustrating part kya hai? Company agla kaam kaise decide karti hai? Poori list (5 categories) is SPA ke Final Questions section me hai.

Q15Offer milne par negotiate kaise karun?

Hamesha negotiate karo — initial offer kabhi best offer nahi hota, aur recruiters expect karte hain ki tum negotiate karoge. 10 rules yaad rakho: sab kuch likh lo; door khula rakho (power mat chhodo); information protect karo (current salary mat batao); positive raho; decision maker mat bano (family/partner ka reference do); alternatives rakho (multiple offers best leverage hai); har request ke liye reason do; sirf paise nahi, training/team/mentor bhi negotiate karo; samjho company kya value karti hai (stock dena sabse aasaan hai); aur winnable raho — company ko clear path do.

Q16Compensation me base, bonus, equity aur signing bonus kya hote hain?

Base salary fixed amount hai — company performance se unaffected. Bonus semi-annual hota hai aur 3 multipliers par depend karta hai: seniority, individual performance (100% meet, 150% exceed, 200% crush, top performers ke liye 300% tak) aur company performance. Equity (stock options ya RSUs) aam taur par 4 saal me vest hoti hai, 1 saal cliff ke saath. Signing bonus one-time lump sum hota hai — aam taur par $10,000–20,000, Google me $50,000 aur Facebook me $100,000 tak. Bonus formula aur Google/Facebook ke level-wise salary tables is SPA ke Compensation section me hain.

Q17Stock options aur RSUs me kya farq hai?

Stock options stocks khareedne ka right hote hain — ek fixed strike price par (grant ke waqt ki fair market value). Free nahi hote; company chhodte waqt exercise window me unhe khareedna padta hai. RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) stock grants hote hain — stock tumhe immediately mil jaata hai; company public ho to trading windows me bech sakte ho. Options aam taur par mid-stage companies deti hain, RSUs badi public companies deti hain.

Q18Engineering levels kya hote hain — Junior se Distinguished tak?

Aam taur par 7 levels hote hain: Junior (0–2 saal, task-level, individual influence), Software Engineer (2–5 saal, features/small projects), Senior (5+ saal, team influence, large features), Staff (10+ saal, multiple teams, critical components), Senior Staff (15+ saal, org/company influence), Principal (company/industry influence, technical vision) aur Distinguished (industry influence, technical strategy). Har level par scope aur influence badhta hai — sirf coding nahi, leadership aur impact matter karta hai.

Q19Companies ke beech choose karte waqt kya dekhu?

8 factors dekho: Compensation (base vs stocks, vesting schedule — linear ya backloaded, cliffs); Products (domain pasand hai? kaunsi team/office me kaam hoga?); Company prospects (stocks ki value badhegi?); Career growth (promotion speed — Meta fast, Google slow); Company culture (Googleyness, 'move fast', people over process); Engineering culture (12-point test — code reviews, CI, oncall, career ladder, feedback culture); Work-life balance (dollars per hour se socho); aur Transfers/mobility (global offices, relocate kar sakte ho?).

Q20Coding interview me Big-O complexity kyun important hai?

Interviewer tumhari approach ki time aur space complexity poochhega — aur optimize karne ko kahega. BTTC (Best Theoretical Time Complexity) jaanna important hai: wo complexity jise hara nahi sakte — jaise array ka sum O(n) se fast nahi ho sakta. Agar tumhara solution BTTC se slow hai to improve karne ka scope hai. Har data structure ki complexities is SPA ke Algorithms sections me tables ke saath hain — Array, Hash Table, Tree, Graph, Heap, Stack, Queue sab ke liye.

Q21Sliding window aur two pointers me kya farq hai?

Sliding window me dono pointers same direction me chalte hain aur kabhi ek-doosre ko overtake nahi karte — har value zyada se zyada do baar visit hoti hai, time O(n) rehta hai. Ye subarray/substring problems me use hoti hai (Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters, Minimum Window Substring). Two pointers zyada general hai — pointers cross kar sakte hain aur alag arrays par ho sakte hain (Sort Colors, Palindromic Substrings, do sorted arrays merge karna).

Q22Recursion me stack overflow kyun hota hai?

Recursion implicitly stack use karti hai — har recursive call stack par ek frame add karta hai. Agar recursion level bahut deep jaaye to stack overflow ho jaata hai (Python me default limit 1000 hai). Har recursive approach ko stack use karke iterative bhi likha ja sakta hai. Interview me ye point batane par bonus mil sakta hai. Aur yaad rakho — recursion kabhi O(1) space nahi ho sakti, kyunki stack involve hota hai (sirf tail-call optimization ho to alag baat).

Q23Tree traversals — in-order, pre-order, post-order me kya farq hai?

In-order (Left → Root → Right): BST me elements sorted order me milte hain. Pre-order (Root → Left → Right): root pehle aata hai. Post-order (Left → Right → Root): root aakhri me aata hai. Is SPA ke tree diagram wale example me: in-order 2, 7, 5, 6, 11, 1, 9, 5, 9; pre-order 1, 7, 2, 6, 5, 11, 9, 9, 5; post-order 2, 5, 11, 6, 7, 5, 9, 9, 1. Dhyaan rakho: in-order akele tree ko uniquely serialize nahi kar sakti — pre-order ya post-order bhi chahiye.

Q24Graph me BFS aur DFS kab use karun?

Dono ki time complexity O(V + E) hai. BFS queue use karta hai — level-by-level traverse karta hai, isliye shortest path (unweighted) aur level-order traversal ke liye best hai. DFS stack (recursion) use karta hai — ek branch me deep jaata hai, isliye connectivity, cycle detection aur topological sort ke liye use hota hai. Matrix problems me dono ke templates is SPA ke Graph section me hain. Tree jaisa diagram graph bhi ho sakta hai — cycles handle karne ke liye visited set rakho.

Q25Hash table kab use karun?

Hash table space-time tradeoff ka best example hai — lookup O(1) average me milta hai. Jab baar-baar check karna ho ki element present hai ya nahi (Two Sum, Group Anagrams, Ransom Note), ya frequency count karni ho, to hash table use karo. Collision handling (separate chaining, open addressing) ki detail interviews me aam taur par nahi poochhi jaati. LRU Cache hash map + doubly-linked list se banta hai — get aur put dono O(1) ho jaate hain.

Q26Dynamic programming kab use hoti hai?

DP optimization problems solve karne ke liye use hoti hai — jab problem me overlapping subproblems aur optimal substructure ho. DP me behtar hone ka ek hi tareeka hai: practice. Memoization se pehle compute kiye gaye results reuse karo (Fibonacci me fib(3) do baar compute hota hai — memoize karo to O(n) ho jaata hai). Kabhi-kabhi poori DP table store karne ki jaroorat nahi — aakhri do values ya do rows kaafi hoti hain. DP ka ROI low hai — Google target hai to zaroor padho, warna time kam ho to skip kar sakte ho.

Q27Mock interviews kab aur kahan se dun?

Mock interviews tab schedule karo jab study plan ka lagbhag 60% poora ho gaya ho. interviewing.io sabse achha platform hai — Google aur Facebook ke engineers ke saath anonymous mock interviews, aur achha karne par jobs page unlock hota hai (Uber, Lyft, Quora, Asana). Dost ke saath partner bankar bhi practice kar sakte ho — baari-baari interview lo. Mock me bhi asli interview jaisa behave karo — self introduction, clarifying questions, approach discussion aur test cases, sab kuch.

Q28Top companies ke interview formats me kya farq hai?

Har company ka format alag hai. Google me 2–4 algorithm rounds + General Cognitive Ability/Leadership/'Googleyness' round + team matching hoti hai. Meta me 2 coding + 1 behavioral + 1 design round hota hai, sirf whiteboard par. Airbnb me 2 cross-functional rounds hote hain (cultural fit bahut important). Amazon me Leadership Principles par behavioral questions hote hain. 9 companies ke poore formats (Airbnb, Asana, Dropbox, Google, Indeed, Lyft, Meta, Palantir, WhatsApp) is SPA ke Interview Formats section me hain.

Q29Interviewer cheatsheet se candidate ko kya fayda hai?

Interviewer kya dekhta hai, ye jaanne se tum apna behavior us hisaab se shape kar sakte ho. Interviewers ye note karte hain: positive aur negative signals (rubric ke hisaab se), har question par kitna time laga, test cases aur edge cases, aur time/space complexity analysis. Wo hints dete hain, solution bolne ko kehte hain, aur 5 minute bache hon to rok dete hain. Agar tumhe pata ho ki wo kya track kar rahe hain, to tum un signals ko proactively dikha sakte ho.

Q30Career growth ke liye hire hone ke baad kya karun?

Hire hone ke baad stagnate mat ho — career growth par focus karo. Newsletters padho (High Growth Engineer, Pragmatic Engineer, Level Up Software Engineering), books padho (Software Engineer's Guidebook, StaffEng.com, Get Promoted), YouTube channels dekho (Fireship, NeetCode, LeadDev) aur communities join karo (Taro, GreatFrontEnd). Promotion ke liye scope badhao — team se org level tak impact dikhao, mentorship karo aur technical strategy me contribute karo.

Q31Interview ki taiyaari ke liye Grind 75 kya hai?

Grind 75 ek free tool hai jo tumhare bache hue time ke hisaab se custom coding interview study plan generate karta hai. Iske peeche algorithm questions ko priority ke hisaab se rank karta hai aur topics me breadth aur depth ka balance rakhta hai. 3-month plan ke Week 5–12 ke 75 questions isi se generate kiye gaye hain. Time kam ho (1 mahina ya 1 hafta) to bhi isse plan bana sakte ho — difficulty aur topics se filter bhi kar sakte ho.

Q32OOP interview questions kaise solve karun?

OOP interviews me design questions poochhe jaate hain — classes, objects aur unke relationships design karne hote hain. Handbook ke sample questions: chess game, library book keeping system, HTTP server, garbage collector, HR system, elevator system aur parking lot system. Approach: requirements clarify karo, main classes identify karo, unke attributes aur methods define karo, relationships (inheritance, composition) dikhao aur design patterns discuss karo. Poore OOD designs code ke saath System Design Primer SPA ke Part F me hain.

Q33Trie kab use karna chahiye?

Trie (prefix tree) strings store aur search karne ke liye use hota hai — autocomplete aur prefix search ke liye best hai. Search, insert aur remove — teeno O(m) hote hain, jahan m string ki length hai. Words ki dictionary ko trie me preprocess karne se word search O(k) ho jaata hai, O(n) ke bajay (k = word length, n = total words). Implement Trie (Prefix Tree) LeetCode question se scratch implementation practice karo.

Q34Heap kab use karna chahiye?

Jab baar-baar highest ya lowest priority wala element chahiye ho, ya top/lowest K elements nikaalne hon, to heap use karo. Question me 'top K' ya 'lowest K' dikhe to heap ka signal hai — Top K Frequent Elements, K Closest Points to Origin, Merge K Sorted Lists. Top K largest chahiye hon to size K ka Min Heap use karo; heap ka size K se zyada ho to minimum remove kar do. Find max/min O(1), insert/remove O(log n), heapify O(n) hota hai.

Q35Binary search sirf sorted arrays par hi kaam karta hai?

Binary search ko sorted property chahiye hoti hai — sorted array me number dhoondhna O(log n) hai, largest number nikaalna O(1) hai (aakhri value). Lekin 'sorted' hamesha obvious nahi hota — rotated sorted array bhi partially sorted hota hai (Search in Rotated Sorted Array). Matrix par bhi binary search apply ho sakta hai — 1D/2D index conversion se. BTTC determine karte waqt sorted property par dhyaan do — ye complexity poori tarah badal deti hai.

Q36String questions me sabse common techniques kaunsi hain?

3 main techniques hain: (1) Character counting — hash table ya Counter se frequency count karo; Latin characters ke liye space O(1) hoti hai (26 characters ki fixed range), O(n) nahi. (2) Anagram check — sort karke, prime numbers multiply karke, ya frequency count karke. (3) Palindrome check — string reverse karke, ya do pointers se start/end se andar ki taraf. Palindromes ginne ho to middle se bahar ki taraf do pointers move karo — even aur odd length dono check karo.

Genuinely out of scope — imandari se

  • resume-old.md — resume.md ka purana version, superseded hai — study content nahi
  • algorithms/__template__.md — Naye algorithm guides ke liye blank template — content nahi hai
  • apps/portal (Grind 75 web app code) — Portal app ka code hai, handbook content nahi — link: https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/tree/main/apps/portal
  • algorithms/ implementation code (repo root) — Algorithm solutions ka code hai, study guide content nahi — link: https://github.com/yangshun/tech-interview-handbook/tree/main/algorithms
  • apps/website/blog/ (13 blog posts) — Blog posts hain, handbook docs nahi
  • apps/website/experimental/ aur advertise.md — Website tooling hai, handbook content nahi
  • career-growth.md — LinkedIn profiles list — Personal names ki list thi — jaan-bujh kar include nahi ki gayi
  • Resume examples (teik-jun-resume-new/old.png) — Real person ke resume ki images — share-block risk ki wajah se embed nahi ki gayi
  • System design section ka scope — Handbook ka system-design.md sirf 65 lines ka resource list hai — 7-step framework aur per-question approaches SPA ne mark karke add kiye hain, handbook me framework text nahi hai.
  • Dynamic programming aur OOP guides — Source me chhote hain (DP me sirf intro, OOP me sirf 7 sample questions) — SPA me wahi scope honestly marked hai.
  • Salary tables — Google L3–L8 aur Facebook E3–E7 tables August 2021 ke data par based hain; internship salary figure 2016 ka data hai — dono ko reference only ke roop me mark kiya gaya hai.
  • Linked courses aur videos — Udemy, Coursera, Educative, YouTube courses ke titles aur links sections me hain — course ka content SPA ke andar nahi hai.
  • LeetCode solutions — Question lists aur links hain, solutions LeetCode par hain — SPA me solutions nahi hain.
  • Interviewer Cheatsheet — Sirf key points hain, detail nahi — source me bhi yehi scope hai.
